Implement the following plan:

# Plan: Claude Session Git Store

## Context

Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts, linked bidirectionally to commits and PRs. Fully automated via hooks — the developer just uses `claude` and `git commit` as normal.

## Directory Layout

```
.ai/
  .active-session        # breadcrumb written by Claude Code hook (gitignored)
  sessions/
    <YYYY-MM-DD>_<HHMM>Z_<slug>__<short-id>/
      meta.json
      transcript.md
      transcript.jsonl
```

- `<slug>`: kebab-cased goal, truncated to 40 chars
- `<short-id>`: first 8 chars of UUID

## Automation Architecture (Two-Layer Hooks)

### Layer 1: Claude Code Hook → writes breadcrumb

In the project's `.claude/settings.json`, register a `PostToolUse` hook that fires after Claude edits files. It writes `.ai/.active-session`:

```json
{
  "session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-22T07:15:00Z",
  "model": "claude-opus-4-6"
}
```

The hook script: `ai-session _mark-active` (an internal subcommand). It reads the `CLAUDE_SESSION_ID` env var (or derives it from the Claude Code project dir) and writes the breadcrumb.

`.ai/.active-session` is gitignored — it's ephemeral.

### Layer 2: Git Hooks → auto-capture on commit

**`prepare-commit-msg` hook:**
1. Check if `.ai/.active-session` exists and is recent (< 2 hours old)
2. If not present → no-op (normal commit)
3. If present:
   - Read the session ID and model from the breadcrumb
   - Use the commit message's first line as the `--goal` (derives slug from it)
   - Run `ai-session new --auto --goal <first-line>` to create the session folder
   - `git add .ai/sessions/<folder>/`
   - Append trailers to the commit message file:
     ```
     Claude-Session: a1b2c3d4
     Claude-Session-Path: .ai/sessions/...
     ```
4. Remove `.ai/.active-session`

**`post-commit` hook:**
1. Check if the commit has a `Claude-Session-Path` trailer
2. If so, backfill `meta.json` with the commit SHA (dirty write, no amend)

**`pre-push` hook:**
1. Scan commits being pushed for `Claude-Session:` trailers
2. Collect all session short-ids referenced
3. Check if current branch has an open PR (`gh pr view` for current branch)
4. If PR exists, auto-update its body with the AI Sessions table (same as `ai-session pr`)
5. If no PR yet, do nothing (the `ai-session pr` command or a future push will handle it)

### Hook installation

`ai-session init` command sets up everything:
1. Creates `.ai/` directory and `.ai/.gitignore` (ignoring `.active-session`)
2. Installs git hooks into `.git/hooks/` (or appends to existing hooks)
3. Adds Claude Code hook config to `.claude/settings.json`
4. Prints setup summary

---

## Files to Create

### 1. `ai-session` — Main CLI (Bash)

Single file, all subcommands in one script.

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `ai-session init` | Set up hooks + `.ai/` directory in current repo |
| `ai-session new` | Manually create a session (also used internally by hooks) |
| `ai-session attach <id> <sha>...` | Retroactively link session to commits |
| `ai-session pr [<id>...] --pr <n>` | Link sessions to PR + update PR body |
| `ai-session list` | List all sessions |
| `ai-session show <id>` | Print session metadata |
| `ai-session resume <sha\|--pr N>` | Launch Claude Code with linked session |
| `ai-session _mark-active` | Internal: write breadcrumb (called by Claude Code hook) |

### `ai-session new` flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--goal "..."` | Summary (required unless used by hook, which derives from commit msg) |
| `--transcript <path>` | Transcript file path |
| `--stdin` | Read transcript from stdin |
| `--auto` | Auto-detect latest Claude Code session |
| `--model <name>` | Model name (default: from breadcrumb or JSONL) |
| `--author <name>` | Author (default: `git config user.name`) |
| `--link <url>` | Repeatable. Arbitrary URLs |
| `--commit` | Stage + commit with trailers (manual mode) |
| `--amend` | Amend last commit with trailers (manual mode) |
| `--repo <path>` | External ai-log repo |

### 2. Git hook scripts

- `.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg` — session capture + trailer injection
- `.git/hooks/post-commit` — backfill commit SHA into meta.json
- `.git/hooks/pre-push` — auto-update PR body

All are thin wrappers that call `ai-session _hook-<name>` subcommands, so the logic stays in one place.

### 3. Claude Code hook

Added to `.claude/settings.json`:
```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Fires after any Edit/Write tool use, ensuring the breadcrumb exists.

### 4. `meta.json` schema

```json
{
  "session_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-...",
  "short_id": "a1b2c3d4",
  "created_at": "2026-02-22T06:31:00Z",
  "author": "grant",
  "repo": "my-project",
  "branch": "fix/websocket-reconnect",
  "goal": "Fix race condition in websocket reconnect",
  "model": "claude-opus-4-6",
  "links": [],
  "commits": ["abc123f", "def456a"],
  "pr": "https://github.com/org/repo/pull/42",
  "claude_session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "transcript_hash": "sha256:..."
}
```

### 5. Transcript conversion

For `--auto`:
1. Derive Claude Code project key from `pwd` (replace `/` with `-`, prepend `-`)
2. Find most recent `.jsonl` in `~/.claude/projects/<key>/`
3. Copy raw `.jsonl` into session folder
4. Convert to `transcript.md` via `jq`: extract `type=user`/`type=assistant` messages → `## User` / `## Assistant` markdown

---

## Fully Automated Workflow (recap)

```bash
ai-session init              # one-time setup per repo

claude                       # work with Claude (hook writes breadcrumb)
git add -p && git commit     # hook auto-captures session + adds trailers
git push                     # hook auto-updates PR body
```

Manual commands still work for edge cases:
```bash
ai-session new --goal "..." --auto --commit    # explicit capture
ai-session attach <id> <sha>                    # retroactive link
ai-session pr <id> --pr 42                      # manual PR link
ai-session resume <sha>                         # reload a session
```

## Verification

1. Run `ai-session init` in a test repo → verify hooks installed, `.ai/` created
2. Simulate Claude Code hook: `ai-session _mark-active` → verify `.ai/.active-session`
3. `git commit` → verify session auto-created, trailers in commit message
4. `git push` with a PR open → verify PR body updated
5. `ai-session resume HEAD` → verify session found and claude launch attempted
6. `ai-session list` / `ai-session show` → verify output
7. Test `--auto` against a real `~/.claude/projects/` directory


If you need specific details from before exiting plan mode (like exact code snippets, error messages, or content you generated), read the full transcript at: /home/grant/.claude/projects/-home-grant-local-code-claude-session-git-store/424a78af-8f71-43d2-b735-683a96b87da9.jsonl

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts
# Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

VERSION="0.1.0"
AI_DIR=".ai"
SESSIONS_DIR="$AI_DIR/sessions"
BREADCRUMB="$AI_DIR/.active-session"
STALE_HOURS=2

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

die()  { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; }

slugify() {
  # kebab-case, truncate to 40 chars
  printf '%s' "$1" \
    | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' \
    | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' \
    | cut -c1-40
}

short_id() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | cut -c1-8
}

now_iso() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
}

now_folder_prefix() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%MZ'
}

gen_uuid() {
  if command -v uuidgen &>/dev/null; then
    uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
  elif [[ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid ]]; then
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid
  else
    python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'
  fi
}

file_age_hours() {
  local file="$1"
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo 9999
    return
  fi
  local now file_epoch
  now=$(date +%s)
  file_epoch=$(stat -c '%Y' "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%m' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  echo $(( (now - file_epoch) / 3600 ))
}

repo_name() {
  basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
}

current_branch() {
  git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

git_author() {
  git config user.name 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

# Derive Claude Code project key from pwd
claude_project_key() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  printf '%s' "$toplevel" | sed 's|/|-|g'
}

# Find most recent JSONL in Claude projects dir
find_latest_jsonl() {
  local key="$1"
  local projects_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$key"
  if [[ ! -d "$projects_dir" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  # Find most recently modified .jsonl
  find "$projects_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jsonl' -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -f2
}

# Convert JSONL transcript to Markdown
jsonl_to_markdown() {
  local jsonl_path="$1"
  jq -r '
    if .type == "human" then
      "\n## User\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "array" then
          [.message[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
        elif (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    elif .type == "assistant" then
      "\n## Assistant\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    else
      empty
    end
  ' "$jsonl_path" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Compute sha256 hash of a file
file_sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
    sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
    shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else
    echo "unknown"
  fi
}

# Read a trailer value from git commit message
get_trailer() {
  local commit="$1" trailer="$2"
  git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key='"$trailer"',valueonly)' "$commit" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

# ─── Subcommands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_init() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Create .ai directory structure
  mkdir -p "$SESSIONS_DIR"

  # Create .ai/.gitignore
  cat > "$AI_DIR/.gitignore" << 'EOF'
.active-session
EOF

  # Install git hooks
  local hooks_dir="$toplevel/.git/hooks"
  mkdir -p "$hooks_dir"

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/prepare-commit-msg" "_hook_prepare_commit_msg" \
    'ai-session _hook-prepare-commit-msg "$@"'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/post-commit" "_hook_post_commit" \
    'ai-session _hook-post-commit'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/pre-push" "_hook_pre_push" \
    'ai-session _hook-pre-push "$@"'

  # Add Claude Code hook to .claude/settings.json
  _install_claude_hook "$toplevel"

  info "ai-session: initialized in $toplevel"
  info "  .ai/ directory created"
  info "  git hooks installed (prepare-commit-msg, post-commit, pre-push)"
  info "  Claude Code hook added to .claude/settings.json"
}

_install_hook() {
  local hook_file="$1" marker="$2" command="$3"

  if [[ -f "$hook_file" ]]; then
    # Check if already installed
    if grep -q "$marker" "$hook_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Append to existing hook
    cat >> "$hook_file" << EOF

# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  else
    cat > "$hook_file" << EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  fi
  chmod +x "$hook_file"
}

_install_claude_hook() {
  local toplevel="$1"
  local settings_dir="$toplevel/.claude"
  local settings_file="$settings_dir/settings.json"

  mkdir -p "$settings_dir"

  if [[ -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
    # Check if hook already exists
    if jq -e '.hooks.PostToolUse[]? | select(.command == "ai-session _mark-active")' "$settings_file" &>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Merge hook into existing settings
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    jq '
      .hooks //= {} |
      .hooks.PostToolUse //= [] |
      .hooks.PostToolUse += [{"matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "ai-session _mark-active"}]
    ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
  else
    cat > "$settings_file" << 'EOF'
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
  fi
}

cmd_new() {
  local goal="" transcript_path="" from_stdin=false auto_detect=false
  local model="" author="" commit_mode="" repo_path=""
  local -a links=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --goal)       goal="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --transcript) transcript_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --stdin)      from_stdin=true; shift ;;
      --auto)       auto_detect=true; shift ;;
      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --author)     author="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --link)       links+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      --commit)     commit_mode="commit"; shift ;;
      --amend)      commit_mode="amend"; shift ;;
      --repo)       repo_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)            die "unknown option: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$goal" ]] || die "missing --goal"

  local session_id claude_session_id=""
  local slug prefix folder_name session_dir

  # Read breadcrumb if available
  if [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]]; then
    claude_session_id=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -z "$model" ]] && model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  # Generate session ID
  if [[ -n "$claude_session_id" ]]; then
    session_id="$claude_session_id"
  else
    session_id=$(gen_uuid)
  fi

  local sid
  sid=$(short_id "$session_id")
  slug=$(slugify "$goal")
  prefix=$(now_folder_prefix)
  folder_name="${prefix}_${slug}__${sid}"

  # Determine target directory
  local base_dir
  if [[ -n "$repo_path" ]]; then
    base_dir="$repo_path"
  else
    base_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  fi
  session_dir="$base_dir/$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  mkdir -p "$session_dir"

  # Handle transcript
  local transcript_hash=""
  if [[ "$auto_detect" == true ]]; then
    local key jsonl_src
    key=$(claude_project_key)
    jsonl_src=$(find_latest_jsonl "$key" || true)
    if [[ -n "$jsonl_src" ]]; then
      cp "$jsonl_src" "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl"
      jsonl_to_markdown "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
      transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl")"
      # Derive model from JSONL if not set
      if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
        model=$(jq -r 'select(.model) | .model' "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      fi
    fi
  elif [[ "$from_stdin" == true ]]; then
    cat > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.md")"
  elif [[ -n "$transcript_path" ]]; then
    cp "$transcript_path" "$session_dir/"
    local basename_t
    basename_t=$(basename "$transcript_path")
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/$basename_t")"
  fi

  [[ -z "$author" ]] && author=$(git_author)
  [[ -z "$model" ]] && model="unknown"

  # Build links JSON array
  local links_json="[]"
  if [[ ${#links[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    links_json=$(printf '%s\n' "${links[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
  fi

  # Write meta.json
  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg short_id "$sid" \
    --arg created_at "$(now_iso)" \
    --arg author "$author" \
    --arg repo "$(repo_name)" \
    --arg branch "$(current_branch)" \
    --arg goal "$goal" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    --argjson links "$links_json" \
    --arg claude_session_id "$claude_session_id" \
    --arg transcript_hash "$transcript_hash" \
    '{
      session_id: $session_id,
      short_id: $short_id,
      created_at: $created_at,
      author: $author,
      repo: $repo,
      branch: $branch,
      goal: $goal,
      model: $model,
      links: $links,
      commits: [],
      pr: null,
      claude_session_id: (if $claude_session_id == "" then null else $claude_session_id end),
      transcript_hash: (if $transcript_hash == "" then null else $transcript_hash end)
    }' > "$session_dir/meta.json"

  # Handle commit/amend mode
  if [[ "$commit_mode" == "commit" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit -m "ai-session: $goal" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  elif [[ "$commit_mode" == "amend" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit --amend --no-edit \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  fi

  # Output the folder name for callers
  echo "$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
}

cmd_attach() {
  [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session attach <short-id> <sha>..."

  local target_id="$1"; shift
  local -a shas=("$@")

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # Find session directory by short-id
  local session_dir=""
  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
      session_dir="$d"
      break
    fi
  done
  [[ -n "$session_dir" ]] || die "session not found: $target_id"

  local meta="$session_dir/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found in $session_dir"

  # Add commits to meta.json
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --argjson new_commits "$(printf '%s\n' "${shas[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)" \
    '.commits = (.commits + $new_commits | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"

  info "attached ${#shas[@]} commit(s) to session $target_id"
}

cmd_pr() {
  local -a session_ids=()
  local pr_number=""

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --pr) pr_number="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)    session_ids+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # If no PR specified, try current branch
  if [[ -z "$pr_number" ]]; then
    pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || die "no open PR found for current branch; use --pr <number>"
  fi

  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot find PR #$pr_number"

  # If no session IDs, scan commits on this branch vs base
  if [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    local base
    base=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName' 2>/dev/null || echo "main")
    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$base"..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  fi

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { info "no sessions found to link"; return 0; }

  # Update each session's meta.json with PR link
  for sid in "${session_ids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local tmp
        tmp=$(mktemp)
        jq --arg pr "$pr_url" '.pr = $pr' "$d/meta.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$d/meta.json"
      fi
    done
  done

  # Build AI Sessions table for PR body
  local table
  table=$(_build_pr_table "$toplevel" "${session_ids[@]}")

  # Update PR body
  local current_body
  current_body=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json body -q '.body' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  local marker_start="<!-- ai-sessions-start -->"
  local marker_end="<!-- ai-sessions-end -->"
  local new_section
  new_section=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s' "$marker_start" "$table" "$marker_end")

  local new_body
  if echo "$current_body" | grep -q "$marker_start"; then
    # Replace existing section
    new_body=$(echo "$current_body" | sed "/$marker_start/,/$marker_end/c\\
$new_section")
  else
    # Append section
    new_body=$(printf '%s\n\n---\n\n%s' "$current_body" "$new_section")
  fi

  gh pr edit "$pr_number" --body "$new_body"
  info "updated PR #$pr_number with ${#session_ids[@]} session(s)"
}

_build_pr_table() {
  local toplevel="$1"; shift
  local -a sids=("$@")

  echo "### AI Sessions"
  echo ""
  echo "| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |"
  echo "|---------|------|-------|---------|"

  for sid in "${sids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local goal model commits_str
        goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$d/meta.json")
        model=$(jq -r '.model' "$d/meta.json")
        commits_str=$(jq -r '.commits | map(.[0:7]) | join(", ")' "$d/meta.json")
        local rel_path="${d#$toplevel/}"
        echo "| [\`$sid\`]($rel_path) | $goal | $model | $commits_str |"
      fi
    done
  done
}

cmd_list() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local found=false
  for meta in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*/meta.json; do
    [[ -f "$meta" ]] || continue
    found=true
    local sid goal created model
    sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")
    goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")
    created=$(jq -r '.created_at' "$meta")
    model=$(jq -r '.model' "$meta")
    printf '%-10s %-20s %-20s %s\n' "$sid" "$created" "$model" "$goal"
  done

  if [[ "$found" == false ]]; then
    info "no sessions found"
  fi
}

cmd_show() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session show <short-id>"
  local target_id="$1"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
      jq . "$d/meta.json"
      return 0
    fi
  done

  die "session not found: $target_id"
}

cmd_resume() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>"

  local target="$1"
  local session_path=""

  if [[ "$target" == "--pr" ]]; then
    [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume --pr <number>"
    local pr_num="$2"
    # Find commits from PR, look for session trailers
    local sha
    sha=$(gh pr view "$pr_num" --json commits -q '.commits[-1].oid' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot read PR #$pr_num"
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$sha" "Claude-Session-Path")
  else
    # Treat as a commit SHA (or ref like HEAD)
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$target" "Claude-Session-Path")
  fi

  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || die "no Claude-Session-Path trailer found"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local full_path="$toplevel/$session_path"
  [[ -d "$full_path" ]] || die "session directory not found: $full_path"

  local meta="$full_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found"

  local claude_sid
  claude_sid=$(jq -r '.claude_session_id // empty' "$meta")

  info "session: $(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")"
  info "goal:    $(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")"
  info "model:   $(jq -r '.model' "$meta")"

  if [[ -n "$claude_sid" ]]; then
    info "resuming Claude Code session: $claude_sid"
    exec claude --resume "$claude_sid"
  else
    info "no Claude session ID available; launching new session with transcript context"
    if [[ -f "$full_path/transcript.md" ]]; then
      exec claude --prompt "Previous session transcript is at: $full_path/transcript.md"
    else
      exec claude
    fi
  fi
}

cmd_mark_active() {
  # Internal: write breadcrumb file
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  cd "$toplevel"

  mkdir -p "$AI_DIR"

  local session_id model timestamp
  session_id="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(gen_uuid)}"
  model="${CLAUDE_MODEL:-unknown}"
  timestamp=$(now_iso)

  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    '{session_id: $session_id, timestamp: $timestamp, model: $model}' \
    > "$BREADCRUMB"
}

# ─── Hook Subcommands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg() {
  local msg_file="${1:-}"
  local commit_source="${2:-}"
  local commit_sha="${3:-}"

  # Skip for merge/squash/amend commits
  [[ "$commit_source" == "merge" || "$commit_source" == "squash" ]] && return 0

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Check breadcrumb
  [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]] || return 0

  local age
  age=$(file_age_hours "$BREADCRUMB")
  (( age < STALE_HOURS )) || { rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"; return 0; }

  # Read first line of commit message as goal
  local first_line
  first_line=$(head -1 "$msg_file" | sed 's/^#.*//; s/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
  [[ -n "$first_line" ]] || return 0

  # Create session
  local session_path
  session_path=$(cmd_new --goal "$first_line" --auto 2>/dev/null) || return 0

  # Read short_id from the created meta.json
  local sid
  sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$sid" ]] || return 0

  # Stage session files
  git add "$session_path" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Append trailers to commit message
  # Use git interpret-trailers for proper formatting
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  git interpret-trailers \
    --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
    --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $session_path" \
    --in-place "$msg_file" 2>/dev/null || {
    # Fallback: manually append
    printf '\n\nClaude-Session: %s\nClaude-Session-Path: %s\n' "$sid" "$session_path" >> "$msg_file"
  }

  # Remove breadcrumb
  rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"
}

cmd_hook_post_commit() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  local session_path
  session_path=$(get_trailer HEAD "Claude-Session-Path")
  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || return 0

  local meta="$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || return 0

  local commit_sha
  commit_sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

  # Backfill commit SHA into meta.json (dirty write, no amend)
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --arg sha "$commit_sha" '.commits = (.commits + [$sha] | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"
}

cmd_hook_pre_push() {
  local remote="${1:-origin}"
  local url="${2:-}"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Collect session IDs from commits being pushed
  local -a session_ids=()

  # Read stdin for refs being pushed
  while IFS=' ' read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
    [[ "$local_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]] && continue

    local range
    if [[ "$remote_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
      range="$local_sha"
    else
      range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
    fi

    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$range" --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  done

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0

  # Check if current branch has an open PR
  local pr_number
  pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || return 0

  # Auto-update PR body
  cmd_pr "${session_ids[@]}" --pr "$pr_number" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# ─── Main Dispatch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_help() {
  cat << 'EOF'
ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts

Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                Set up hooks + .ai/ directory in current repo
  new                 Create a new session
  attach <id> <sha>   Link session to commit(s)
  pr [<id>...] --pr N Link sessions to PR + update PR body
  list                List all sessions
  show <id>           Print session metadata
  resume <sha|--pr N> Launch Claude Code with linked session
  _mark-active        Internal: write breadcrumb (Claude Code hook)

new flags:
  --goal "..."        Summary (required)
  --transcript <path> Transcript file path
  --stdin             Read transcript from stdin
  --auto              Auto-detect latest Claude Code session
  --model <name>      Model name
  --author <name>     Author (default: git user.name)
  --link <url>        Arbitrary URL (repeatable)
  --commit            Stage + commit with trailers
  --amend             Amend last commit with trailers
  --repo <path>       External ai-log repo
EOF
}

main() {
  local cmd="${1:-help}"
  shift || true

  case "$cmd" in
    init)                    cmd_init "$@" ;;
    new)                     cmd_new "$@" ;;
    attach)                  cmd_attach "$@" ;;
    pr)                      cmd_pr "$@" ;;
    list)                    cmd_list "$@" ;;
    show)                    cmd_show "$@" ;;
    resume)                  cmd_resume "$@" ;;
    _mark-active)            cmd_mark_active "$@" ;;
    _hook-prepare-commit-msg) cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg "$@" ;;
    _hook-post-commit)       cmd_hook_post_commit "$@" ;;
    _hook-pre-push)          cmd_hook_pre_push "$@" ;;
    help|--help|-h)          cmd_help ;;
    version|--version|-v)    echo "ai-session $VERSION" ;;
    *)                       die "unknown command: $cmd" ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts
# Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

VERSION="0.1.0"
AI_DIR=".ai"
SESSIONS_DIR="$AI_DIR/sessions"
BREADCRUMB="$AI_DIR/.active-session"
STALE_HOURS=2

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

die()  { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; }

slugify() {
  # kebab-case, truncate to 40 chars
  printf '%s' "$1" \
    | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' \
    | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' \
    | cut -c1-40
}

short_id() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | cut -c1-8
}

now_iso() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
}

now_folder_prefix() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%MZ'
}

gen_uuid() {
  if command -v uuidgen &>/dev/null; then
    uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
  elif [[ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid ]]; then
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid
  else
    python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'
  fi
}

file_age_hours() {
  local file="$1"
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo 9999
    return
  fi
  local now file_epoch
  now=$(date +%s)
  file_epoch=$(stat -c '%Y' "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%m' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  echo $(( (now - file_epoch) / 3600 ))
}

repo_name() {
  basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
}

current_branch() {
  git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

git_author() {
  git config user.name 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

# Derive Claude Code project key from pwd
claude_project_key() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  printf '%s' "$toplevel" | sed 's|/|-|g'
}

# Find most recent JSONL in Claude projects dir
find_latest_jsonl() {
  local key="$1"
  local projects_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$key"
  if [[ ! -d "$projects_dir" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  # Find most recently modified .jsonl
  find "$projects_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jsonl' -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -f2
}

# Convert JSONL transcript to Markdown
jsonl_to_markdown() {
  local jsonl_path="$1"
  jq -r '
    if .type == "human" then
      "\n## User\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "array" then
          [.message[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
        elif (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    elif .type == "assistant" then
      "\n## Assistant\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    else
      empty
    end
  ' "$jsonl_path" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Compute sha256 hash of a file
file_sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
    sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
    shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else
    echo "unknown"
  fi
}

# Read a trailer value from git commit message
get_trailer() {
  local commit="$1" trailer="$2"
  git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key='"$trailer"',valueonly)' "$commit" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

# ─── Subcommands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_init() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Create .ai directory structure
  mkdir -p "$SESSIONS_DIR"

  # Create .ai/.gitignore
  cat > "$AI_DIR/.gitignore" << 'EOF'
.active-session
EOF

  # Install git hooks
  local hooks_dir="$toplevel/.git/hooks"
  mkdir -p "$hooks_dir"

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/prepare-commit-msg" "_hook_prepare_commit_msg" \
    'ai-session _hook-prepare-commit-msg "$@"'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/post-commit" "_hook_post_commit" \
    'ai-session _hook-post-commit'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/pre-push" "_hook_pre_push" \
    'ai-session _hook-pre-push "$@"'

  # Add Claude Code hook to .claude/settings.json
  _install_claude_hook "$toplevel"

  info "ai-session: initialized in $toplevel"
  info "  .ai/ directory created"
  info "  git hooks installed (prepare-commit-msg, post-commit, pre-push)"
  info "  Claude Code hook added to .claude/settings.json"
}

_install_hook() {
  local hook_file="$1" marker="$2" command="$3"

  if [[ -f "$hook_file" ]]; then
    # Check if already installed
    if grep -q "$marker" "$hook_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Append to existing hook
    cat >> "$hook_file" << EOF

# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  else
    cat > "$hook_file" << EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  fi
  chmod +x "$hook_file"
}

_install_claude_hook() {
  local toplevel="$1"
  local settings_dir="$toplevel/.claude"
  local settings_file="$settings_dir/settings.json"

  mkdir -p "$settings_dir"

  if [[ -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
    # Check if hook already exists
    if jq -e '.hooks.PostToolUse[]? | select(.command == "ai-session _mark-active")' "$settings_file" &>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Merge hook into existing settings
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    jq '
      .hooks //= {} |
      .hooks.PostToolUse //= [] |
      .hooks.PostToolUse += [{"matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "ai-session _mark-active"}]
    ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
  else
    cat > "$settings_file" << 'EOF'
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
  fi
}

cmd_new() {
  local goal="" transcript_path="" from_stdin=false auto_detect=false
  local model="" author="" commit_mode="" repo_path=""
  local -a links=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --goal)       goal="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --transcript) transcript_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --stdin)      from_stdin=true; shift ;;
      --auto)       auto_detect=true; shift ;;
      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --author)     author="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --link)       links+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      --commit)     commit_mode="commit"; shift ;;
      --amend)      commit_mode="amend"; shift ;;
      --repo)       repo_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)            die "unknown option: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$goal" ]] || die "missing --goal"

  local session_id claude_session_id=""
  local slug prefix folder_name session_dir

  # Read breadcrumb if available
  if [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]]; then
    claude_session_id=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -z "$model" ]] && model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  # Generate session ID
  if [[ -n "$claude_session_id" ]]; then
    session_id="$claude_session_id"
  else
    session_id=$(gen_uuid)
  fi

  local sid
  sid=$(short_id "$session_id")
  slug=$(slugify "$goal")
  prefix=$(now_folder_prefix)
  folder_name="${prefix}_${slug}__${sid}"

  # Determine target directory
  local base_dir
  if [[ -n "$repo_path" ]]; then
    base_dir="$repo_path"
  else
    base_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  fi
  session_dir="$base_dir/$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  mkdir -p "$session_dir"

  # Handle transcript
  local transcript_hash=""
  if [[ "$auto_detect" == true ]]; then
    local key jsonl_src
    key=$(claude_project_key)
    jsonl_src=$(find_latest_jsonl "$key" || true)
    if [[ -n "$jsonl_src" ]]; then
      cp "$jsonl_src" "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl"
      jsonl_to_markdown "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
      transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl")"
      # Derive model from JSONL if not set
      if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
        model=$(jq -r 'select(.model) | .model' "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      fi
    fi
  elif [[ "$from_stdin" == true ]]; then
    cat > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.md")"
  elif [[ -n "$transcript_path" ]]; then
    cp "$transcript_path" "$session_dir/"
    local basename_t
    basename_t=$(basename "$transcript_path")
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/$basename_t")"
  fi

  [[ -z "$author" ]] && author=$(git_author)
  [[ -z "$model" ]] && model="unknown"

  # Build links JSON array
  local links_json="[]"
  if [[ ${#links[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    links_json=$(printf '%s\n' "${links[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
  fi

  # Write meta.json
  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg short_id "$sid" \
    --arg created_at "$(now_iso)" \
    --arg author "$author" \
    --arg repo "$(repo_name)" \
    --arg branch "$(current_branch)" \
    --arg goal "$goal" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    --argjson links "$links_json" \
    --arg claude_session_id "$claude_session_id" \
    --arg transcript_hash "$transcript_hash" \
    '{
      session_id: $session_id,
      short_id: $short_id,
      created_at: $created_at,
      author: $author,
      repo: $repo,
      branch: $branch,
      goal: $goal,
      model: $model,
      links: $links,
      commits: [],
      pr: null,
      claude_session_id: (if $claude_session_id == "" then null else $claude_session_id end),
      transcript_hash: (if $transcript_hash == "" then null else $transcript_hash end)
    }' > "$session_dir/meta.json"

  # Handle commit/amend mode
  if [[ "$commit_mode" == "commit" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit -m "ai-session: $goal" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  elif [[ "$commit_mode" == "amend" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit --amend --no-edit \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  fi

  # Output the folder name for callers
  echo "$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
}

cmd_attach() {
  [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session attach <short-id> <sha>..."

  local target_id="$1"; shift
  local -a shas=("$@")

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # Find session directory by short-id
  local session_dir=""
  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
      session_dir="$d"
      break
    fi
  done
  [[ -n "$session_dir" ]] || die "session not found: $target_id"

  local meta="$session_dir/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found in $session_dir"

  # Add commits to meta.json
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --argjson new_commits "$(printf '%s\n' "${shas[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)" \
    '.commits = (.commits + $new_commits | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"

  info "attached ${#shas[@]} commit(s) to session $target_id"
}

cmd_pr() {
  local -a session_ids=()
  local pr_number=""

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --pr) pr_number="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)    session_ids+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # If no PR specified, try current branch
  if [[ -z "$pr_number" ]]; then
    pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || die "no open PR found for current branch; use --pr <number>"
  fi

  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot find PR #$pr_number"

  # If no session IDs, scan commits on this branch vs base
  if [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    local base
    base=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName' 2>/dev/null || echo "main")
    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$base"..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  fi

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { info "no sessions found to link"; return 0; }

  # Update each session's meta.json with PR link
  for sid in "${session_ids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local tmp
        tmp=$(mktemp)
        jq --arg pr "$pr_url" '.pr = $pr' "$d/meta.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$d/meta.json"
      fi
    done
  done

  # Build AI Sessions table for PR body
  local table
  table=$(_build_pr_table "$toplevel" "${session_ids[@]}")

  # Update PR body
  local current_body
  current_body=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json body -q '.body' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  local marker_start="<!-- ai-sessions-start -->"
  local marker_end="<!-- ai-sessions-end -->"
  local new_section
  new_section=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s' "$marker_start" "$table" "$marker_end")

  local new_body
  if echo "$current_body" | grep -q "$marker_start"; then
    # Replace existing section
    new_body=$(echo "$current_body" | sed "/$marker_start/,/$marker_end/c\\
$new_section")
  else
    # Append section
    new_body=$(printf '%s\n\n---\n\n%s' "$current_body" "$new_section")
  fi

  gh pr edit "$pr_number" --body "$new_body"
  info "updated PR #$pr_number with ${#session_ids[@]} session(s)"
}

_build_pr_table() {
  local toplevel="$1"; shift
  local -a sids=("$@")

  echo "### AI Sessions"
  echo ""
  echo "| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |"
  echo "|---------|------|-------|---------|"

  for sid in "${sids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local goal model commits_str
        goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$d/meta.json")
        model=$(jq -r '.model' "$d/meta.json")
        commits_str=$(jq -r '.commits | map(.[0:7]) | join(", ")' "$d/meta.json")
        local rel_path="${d#$toplevel/}"
        echo "| [\`$sid\`]($rel_path) | $goal | $model | $commits_str |"
      fi
    done
  done
}

cmd_list() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local found=false
  for meta in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*/meta.json; do
    [[ -f "$meta" ]] || continue
    found=true
    local sid goal created model
    sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")
    goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")
    created=$(jq -r '.created_at' "$meta")
    model=$(jq -r '.model' "$meta")
    printf '%-10s %-20s %-20s %s\n' "$sid" "$created" "$model" "$goal"
  done

  if [[ "$found" == false ]]; then
    info "no sessions found"
  fi
}

cmd_show() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session show <short-id>"
  local target_id="$1"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
      jq . "$d/meta.json"
      return 0
    fi
  done

  die "session not found: $target_id"
}

cmd_resume() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>"

  local target="$1"
  local session_path=""

  if [[ "$target" == "--pr" ]]; then
    [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume --pr <number>"
    local pr_num="$2"
    # Find commits from PR, look for session trailers
    local sha
    sha=$(gh pr view "$pr_num" --json commits -q '.commits[-1].oid' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot read PR #$pr_num"
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$sha" "Claude-Session-Path")
  else
    # Treat as a commit SHA (or ref like HEAD)
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$target" "Claude-Session-Path")
  fi

  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || die "no Claude-Session-Path trailer found"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local full_path="$toplevel/$session_path"
  [[ -d "$full_path" ]] || die "session directory not found: $full_path"

  local meta="$full_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found"

  local claude_sid
  claude_sid=$(jq -r '.claude_session_id // empty' "$meta")

  info "session: $(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")"
  info "goal:    $(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")"
  info "model:   $(jq -r '.model' "$meta")"

  if [[ -n "$claude_sid" ]]; then
    info "resuming Claude Code session: $claude_sid"
    exec claude --resume "$claude_sid"
  else
    info "no Claude session ID available; launching new session with transcript context"
    if [[ -f "$full_path/transcript.md" ]]; then
      exec claude --prompt "Previous session transcript is at: $full_path/transcript.md"
    else
      exec claude
    fi
  fi
}

cmd_mark_active() {
  # Internal: write breadcrumb file
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  cd "$toplevel"

  mkdir -p "$AI_DIR"

  local session_id model timestamp
  session_id="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(gen_uuid)}"
  model="${CLAUDE_MODEL:-unknown}"
  timestamp=$(now_iso)

  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    '{session_id: $session_id, timestamp: $timestamp, model: $model}' \
    > "$BREADCRUMB"
}

# ─── Hook Subcommands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg() {
  local msg_file="${1:-}"
  local commit_source="${2:-}"
  local commit_sha="${3:-}"

  # Skip for merge/squash/amend commits
  [[ "$commit_source" == "merge" || "$commit_source" == "squash" ]] && return 0

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Check breadcrumb
  [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]] || return 0

  local age
  age=$(file_age_hours "$BREADCRUMB")
  (( age < STALE_HOURS )) || { rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"; return 0; }

  # Read first line of commit message as goal
  local first_line
  first_line=$(head -1 "$msg_file" | sed 's/^#.*//; s/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
  [[ -n "$first_line" ]] || return 0

  # Create session
  local session_path
  session_path=$(cmd_new --goal "$first_line" --auto 2>/dev/null) || return 0

  # Read short_id from the created meta.json
  local sid
  sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$sid" ]] || return 0

  # Stage session files
  git add "$session_path" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Append trailers to commit message
  # Use git interpret-trailers for proper formatting
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  git interpret-trailers \
    --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
    --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $session_path" \
    --in-place "$msg_file" 2>/dev/null || {
    # Fallback: manually append
    printf '\n\nClaude-Session: %s\nClaude-Session-Path: %s\n' "$sid" "$session_path" >> "$msg_file"
  }

  # Remove breadcrumb
  rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"
}

cmd_hook_post_commit() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  local session_path
  session_path=$(get_trailer HEAD "Claude-Session-Path")
  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || return 0

  local meta="$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || return 0

  local commit_sha
  commit_sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

  # Backfill commit SHA into meta.json (dirty write, no amend)
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --arg sha "$commit_sha" '.commits = (.commits + [$sha] | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"
}

cmd_hook_pre_push() {
  local remote="${1:-origin}"
  local url="${2:-}"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Collect session IDs from commits being pushed
  local -a session_ids=()

  # Read stdin for refs being pushed
  while IFS=' ' read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
    [[ "$local_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]] && continue

    local range
    if [[ "$remote_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
      range="$local_sha"
    else
      range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
    fi

    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$range" --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  done

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0

  # Check if current branch has an open PR
  local pr_number
  pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || return 0

  # Auto-update PR body
  cmd_pr "${session_ids[@]}" --pr "$pr_number" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# ─── Main Dispatch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_help() {
  cat << 'EOF'
ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts

Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                Set up hooks + .ai/ directory in current repo
  new                 Create a new session
  attach <id> <sha>   Link session to commit(s)
  pr [<id>...] --pr N Link sessions to PR + update PR body
  list                List all sessions
  show <id>           Print session metadata
  resume <sha|--pr N> Launch Claude Code with linked session
  _mark-active        Internal: write breadcrumb (Claude Code hook)

new flags:
  --goal "..."        Summary (required)
  --transcript <path> Transcript file path
  --stdin             Read transcript from stdin
  --auto              Auto-detect latest Claude Code session
  --model <name>      Model name
  --author <name>     Author (default: git user.name)
  --link <url>        Arbitrary URL (repeatable)
  --commit            Stage + commit with trailers
  --amend             Amend last commit with trailers
  --repo <path>       External ai-log repo
EOF
}

main() {
  local cmd="${1:-help}"
  shift || true

  case "$cmd" in
    init)                    cmd_init "$@" ;;
    new)                     cmd_new "$@" ;;
    attach)                  cmd_attach "$@" ;;
    pr)                      cmd_pr "$@" ;;
    list)                    cmd_list "$@" ;;
    show)                    cmd_show "$@" ;;
    resume)                  cmd_resume "$@" ;;
    _mark-active)            cmd_mark_active "$@" ;;
    _hook-prepare-commit-msg) cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg "$@" ;;
    _hook-post-commit)       cmd_hook_post_commit "$@" ;;
    _hook-pre-push)          cmd_hook_pre_push "$@" ;;
    help|--help|-h)          cmd_help ;;
    version|--version|-v)    echo "ai-session $VERSION" ;;
    *)                       die "unknown command: $cmd" ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"

Everything is implemented and tested. Here's a summary:

## What was created

**`/home/grant/local_code/claude-session-git-store/ai-session`** — A single Bash script (~500 lines) containing all functionality:

### Commands
| Command | Status |
|---------|--------|
| `ai-session init` | Tested — creates `.ai/`, installs git hooks, adds Claude Code hook to `.claude/settings.json` |
| `ai-session new` | Tested — creates session folder with `meta.json`, supports `--goal`, `--auto`, `--model`, `--link`, `--commit`, `--amend`, etc. |
| `ai-session attach <id> <sha>...` | Tested — retroactively links commits to sessions |
| `ai-session pr [<id>...] --pr <n>` | Implemented — updates PR body with AI Sessions table |
| `ai-session list` | Tested — lists all sessions with short-id, date, model, goal |
| `ai-session show <id>` | Tested — prints full `meta.json` |
| `ai-session resume <sha\|--pr N>` | Implemented — launches Claude Code with linked session |
| `ai-session _mark-active` | Tested — writes `.ai/.active-session` breadcrumb |

### Git Hooks (installed by `init`)
- **`prepare-commit-msg`** — detects breadcrumb, creates session, stages it, appends `Claude-Session:` / `Claude-Session-Path:` trailers
- **`post-commit`** — backfills commit SHA into `meta.json`
- **`pre-push`** — scans for session trailers, auto-updates PR body if PR exists

### Key behaviors verified
- Init is idempotent (no duplicate hooks on re-run)
- Commits without active session are untouched (no-op)
- Commits with active session get full automation (session folder + trailers + commit SHA backfill)
- Manual `new`, `attach`, `list`, `show` all work correctly
- Transcript conversion from JSONL to Markdown via `jq`

### To install
Add the script to your PATH (e.g., symlink to `~/.local/bin/`) then run `ai-session init` in any repo.

   245→cmd_new() {
   246→  local goal="" transcript_path="" from_stdin=false auto_detect=false
   247→  local model="" author="" commit_mode="" repo_path=""
   248→  local -a links=()
   249→
   250→  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   251→    case "$1" in
   252→      --goal)       goal="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   253→      --transcript) transcript_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   254→      --stdin)      from_stdin=true; shift ;;
   255→      --auto)       auto_detect=true; shift ;;
   256→      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   257→      --author)     author="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   258→      --link)       links+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
   259→      --commit)     commit_mode="commit"; shift ;;
   260→      --amend)      commit_mode="amend"; shift ;;
   261→      --repo)       repo_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   262→      *)            die "unknown option: $1" ;;
   263→    esac
   264→  done
   265→
   266→  [[ -n "$goal" ]] || die "missing --goal"
   267→
   268→  local session_id claude_session_id=""
   269→  local slug prefix folder_name session_dir
   270→
   271→  # Read breadcrumb if available
   272→  if [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]]; then
   273→    claude_session_id=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
   274→    [[ -z "$model" ]] && model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
   275→  fi
   276→
   277→  # Generate session ID
   278→  if [[ -n "$claude_session_id" ]]; then
   279→    session_id="$claude_session_id"
   280→  else
   281→    session_id=$(gen_uuid)
   282→  fi
   283→
   284→  local sid
   285→  sid=$(short_id "$session_id")
   286→  slug=$(slugify "$goal")
   287→  prefix=$(now_folder_prefix)
   288→  folder_name="${prefix}_${slug}__${sid}"
   289→
   290→  # Determine target directory
   291→  local base_dir
   292→  if [[ -n "$repo_path" ]]; then
   293→    base_dir="$repo_path"
   294→  else
   295→    base_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
   296→  fi
   297→  session_dir="$base_dir/$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
   298→  mkdir -p "$session_dir"
   299→
   300→  # Handle transcript
   301→  local transcript_hash=""
   302→  if [[ "$auto_detect" == true ]]; then
   303→    local key jsonl_src
   304→    key=$(claude_project_key)
   305→    jsonl_src=$(find_latest_jsonl "$key" || true)
   306→    if [[ -n "$jsonl_src" ]]; then
   307→      cp "$jsonl_src" "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl"
   308→      jsonl_to_markdown "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
   309→      transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl")"
   310→      # Derive model from JSONL if not set
   311→      if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
   312→        model=$(jq -r 'select(.model) | .model' "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
   313→      fi
   314→    fi
   315→  elif [[ "$from_stdin" == true ]]; then
   316→    cat > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
   317→    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.md")"
   318→  elif [[ -n "$transcript_path" ]]; then
   319→    cp "$transcript_path" "$session_dir/"
   320→    local basename_t
   321→    basename_t=$(basename "$transcript_path")
   322→    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/$basename_t")"
   323→  fi
   324→
   325→  [[ -z "$author" ]] && author=$(git_author)
   326→  [[ -z "$model" ]] && model="unknown"
   327→
   328→  # Build links JSON array
   329→  local links_json="[]"
   330→  if [[ ${#links[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   331→    links_json=$(printf '%s\n' "${links[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
   332→  fi
   333→
   334→  # Write meta.json
   335→  jq -n \
   336→    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
   337→    --arg short_id "$sid" \
   338→    --arg created_at "$(now_iso)" \
   339→    --arg author "$author" \
   340→    --arg repo "$(repo_name)" \
   341→    --arg branch "$(current_branch)" \
   342→    --arg goal "$goal" \
   343→    --arg model "$model" \
   344→    --argjson links "$links_json" \
   345→    --arg claude_session_id "$claude_session_id" \
   346→    --arg transcript_hash "$transcript_hash" \
   347→    '{
   348→      session_id: $session_id,
   349→      short_id: $short_id,
   350→      created_at: $created_at,
   351→      author: $author,
   352→      repo: $repo,
   353→      branch: $branch,
   354→      goal: $goal,
   355→      model: $model,
   356→      links: $links,
   357→      commits: [],
   358→      pr: null,
   359→      claude_session_id: (if $claude_session_id == "" then null else $claude_session_id end),
   360→      transcript_hash: (if $transcript_hash == "" then null else $transcript_hash end)
   361→    }' > "$session_dir/meta.json"
   362→
   363→  # Handle commit/amend mode
   364→  if [[ "$commit_mode" == "commit" ]]; then
   365→    git add "$session_dir"
   366→    git commit -m "ai-session: $goal" \
   367→      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
   368→      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
   369→  elif [[ "$commit_mode" == "amend" ]]; then
   370→    git add "$session_dir"
   371→    git commit --amend --no-edit \
   372→      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
   373→      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
   374→  fi
   375→
   376→  # Output the folder name for callers
   377→  echo "$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
   378→}

   411→cmd_pr() {
   412→  local -a session_ids=()
   413→  local pr_number=""
   414→
   415→  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   416→    case "$1" in
   417→      --pr) pr_number="$2"; shift 2 ;;
   418→      *)    session_ids+=("$1"); shift ;;
   419→    esac
   420→  done
   421→
   422→  local toplevel
   423→  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"
   424→
   425→  # If no PR specified, try current branch
   426→  if [[ -z "$pr_number" ]]; then
   427→    pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
   428→    [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || die "no open PR found for current branch; use --pr <number>"
   429→  fi
   430→
   431→  local pr_url
   432→  pr_url=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot find PR #$pr_number"
   433→
   434→  # If no session IDs, scan commits on this branch vs base
   435→  if [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
   436→    local base
   437→    base=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName' 2>/dev/null || echo "main")
   438→    while IFS= read -r sid; do
   439→      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
   440→    done < <(git log "$base"..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
   441→  fi
   442→
   443→  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { info "no sessions found to link"; return 0; }
   444→
   445→  # Update each session's meta.json with PR link
   446→  for sid in "${session_ids[@]}"; do
   447→    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
   448→      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
   449→        local tmp
   450→        tmp=$(mktemp)
   451→        jq --arg pr "$pr_url" '.pr = $pr' "$d/meta.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$d/meta.json"
   452→      fi
   453→    done
   454→  done
   455→
   456→  # Build AI Sessions table for PR body
   457→  local table
   458→  table=$(_build_pr_table "$toplevel" "${session_ids[@]}")
   459→
   460→  # Update PR body
   461→  local current_body
   462→  current_body=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json body -q '.body' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
   463→
   464→  local marker_start="<!-- ai-sessions-start -->"
   465→  local marker_end="<!-- ai-sessions-end -->"
   466→  local new_section
   467→  new_section=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s' "$marker_start" "$table" "$marker_end")
   468→
   469→  local new_body
   470→  if echo "$current_body" | grep -q "$marker_start"; then
   471→    # Replace existing section
   472→    new_body=$(echo "$current_body" | sed "/$marker_start/,/$marker_end/c\\
   473→$new_section")
   474→  else
   475→    # Append section
   476→    new_body=$(printf '%s\n\n---\n\n%s' "$current_body" "$new_section")
   477→  fi
   478→
   479→  gh pr edit "$pr_number" --body "$new_body"
   480→  info "updated PR #$pr_number with ${#session_ids[@]} session(s)"
   481→}

   616→cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg() {
   617→  local msg_file="${1:-}"
   618→  local commit_source="${2:-}"
   619→  local commit_sha="${3:-}"
   620→
   621→  # Skip for merge/squash/amend commits
   622→  [[ "$commit_source" == "merge" || "$commit_source" == "squash" ]] && return 0
   623→
   624→  local toplevel
   625→  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
   626→  cd "$toplevel"
   627→
   628→  # Check breadcrumb
   629→  [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]] || return 0
   630→
   631→  local age
   632→  age=$(file_age_hours "$BREADCRUMB")
   633→  (( age < STALE_HOURS )) || { rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"; return 0; }
   634→
   635→  # Read first line of commit message as goal
   636→  local first_line
   637→  first_line=$(head -1 "$msg_file" | sed 's/^#.*//; s/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
   638→  [[ -n "$first_line" ]] || return 0
   639→
   640→  # Create session
   641→  local session_path
   642→  session_path=$(cmd_new --goal "$first_line" --auto 2>/dev/null) || return 0
   643→
   644→  # Read short_id from the created meta.json
   645→  local sid
   646→  sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
   647→  [[ -n "$sid" ]] || return 0
   648→
   649→  # Stage session files
   650→  git add "$session_path" 2>/dev/null || true
   651→
   652→  # Append trailers to commit message
   653→  # Use git interpret-trailers for proper formatting
   654→  local tmp
   655→  tmp=$(mktemp)
   656→  git interpret-trailers \
   657→    --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
   658→    --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $session_path" \
   659→    --in-place "$msg_file" 2>/dev/null || {
   660→    # Fallback: manually append
   661→    printf '\n\nClaude-Session: %s\nClaude-Session-Path: %s\n' "$sid" "$session_path" >> "$msg_file"
   662→  }
   663→
   664→  # Remove breadcrumb
   665→  rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"
   666→}

   672→
   673→  local session_path

   689→cmd_hook_pre_push() {
   690→  local remote="${1:-origin}"
   691→  local url="${2:-}"
   692→
   693→  local toplevel
   694→  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
   695→  cd "$toplevel"
   696→
   697→  # Collect session IDs from commits being pushed
   698→  local -a session_ids=()
   699→
   700→  # Read stdin for refs being pushed
   701→  while IFS=' ' read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
   702→    [[ "$local_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]] && continue
   703→
   704→    local range
   705→    if [[ "$remote_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
   706→      range="$local_sha"
   707→    else
   708→      range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
   709→    fi
   710→
   711→    while IFS= read -r sid; do
   712→      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
   713→    done < <(git log "$range" --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
   714→  done
   715→
   716→  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0
   717→
   718→  # Check if current branch has an open PR
   719→  local pr_number
   720→  pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
   721→  [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || return 0
   722→
   723→  # Auto-update PR body
   724→  cmd_pr "${session_ids[@]}" --pr "$pr_number" 2>/dev/null || true
   725→}

   729→cmd_help() {
   730→  cat << 'EOF'
   731→ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts
   732→
   733→Usage: ai-session <command> [options]
   734→
   735→Commands:
   736→  init                Set up hooks + .ai/ directory in current repo
   737→  new                 Create a new session
   738→  attach <id> <sha>   Link session to commit(s)
   739→  pr [<id>...] --pr N Link sessions to PR + update PR body
   740→  list                List all sessions
   741→  show <id>           Print session metadata
   742→  resume <sha|--pr N> Launch Claude Code with linked session
   743→  _mark-active        Internal: write breadcrumb (Claude Code hook)
   744→
   745→new flags:
   746→  --goal "..."        Summary (required)
   747→  --transcript <path> Transcript file path
   748→  --stdin             Read transcript from stdin
   749→  --auto              Auto-detect latest Claude Code session
   750→  --model <name>      Model name
   751→  --author <name>     Author (default: git user.name)
   752→  --link <url>        Arbitrary URL (repeatable)
   753→  --commit            Stage + commit with trailers
   754→  --amend             Amend last commit with trailers
   755→  --repo <path>       External ai-log repo
   756→EOF
   757→}
   758→
   759→main() {
   760→  local cmd="${1:-help}"
   761→  shift || true
   762→
   763→  case "$cmd" in
   764→    init)                    cmd_init "$@" ;;
   765→    new)                     cmd_new "$@" ;;
   766→    attach)                  cmd_attach "$@" ;;
   767→    pr)                      cmd_pr "$@" ;;
   768→    list)                    cmd_list "$@" ;;
   769→    show)                    cmd_show "$@" ;;
   770→    resume)                  cmd_resume "$@" ;;
   771→    _mark-active)            cmd_mark_active "$@" ;;
   772→    _hook-prepare-commit-msg) cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg "$@" ;;
   773→    _hook-post-commit)       cmd_hook_post_commit "$@" ;;
   774→    _hook-pre-push)          cmd_hook_pre_push "$@" ;;
   775→    help|--help|-h)          cmd_help ;;
   776→    version|--version|-v)    echo "ai-session $VERSION" ;;
   777→    *)                       die "unknown command: $cmd" ;;
   778→  esac
