file.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts
# Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

VERSION="0.1.0"
AI_DIR=".ai"
SESSIONS_DIR="$AI_DIR/sessions"
BREADCRUMB="$AI_DIR/.active-session"
STALE_HOURS=2

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

die()  { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; }

slugify() {
  # kebab-case, truncate to 40 chars
  printf '%s' "$1" \
    | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' \
    | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' \
    | cut -c1-40
}

short_id() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | cut -c1-8
}

now_iso() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
}

now_folder_prefix() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%MZ'
}

gen_uuid() {
  if command -v uuidgen &>/dev/null; then
    uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
  elif [[ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid ]]; then
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid
  else
    python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'
  fi
}

file_age_hours() {
  local file="$1"
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo 9999
    return
  fi
  local now file_epoch
  now=$(date +%s)
  file_epoch=$(stat -c '%Y' "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%m' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  echo $(( (now - file_epoch) / 3600 ))
}

repo_name() {
  basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
}

current_branch() {
  git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

git_author() {
  git config user.name 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

# Derive Claude Code project key from pwd
claude_project_key() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  printf '%s' "$toplevel" | sed 's|/|-|g'
}

# Find most recent JSONL in Claude projects dir
find_latest_jsonl() {
  local key="$1"
  local projects_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$key"
  if [[ ! -d "$projects_dir" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  # Find most recently modified .jsonl
  find "$projects_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jsonl' -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -f2
}

# Convert JSONL transcript to Markdown
jsonl_to_markdown() {
  local jsonl_path="$1"
  jq -r '
    if .type == "human" then
      "\n## User\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "array" then
          [.message[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
        elif (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    elif .type == "assistant" then
      "\n## Assistant\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    else
      empty
    end
  ' "$jsonl_path" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Compute sha256 hash of a file
file_sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
    sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
    shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else
    echo "unknown"
  fi
}

# Read a trailer value from git commit message
get_trailer() {
  local commit="$1" trailer="$2"
  git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key='"$trailer"',valueonly)' "$commit" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

# ─── Subcommands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_init() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Create .ai directory structure
  mkdir -p "$SESSIONS_DIR"

  # Create .ai/.gitignore
  cat > "$AI_DIR/.gitignore" << 'EOF'
.active-session
EOF

  # Install git hooks
  local hooks_dir="$toplevel/.git/hooks"
  mkdir -p "$hooks_dir"

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/prepare-commit-msg" "_hook_prepare_commit_msg" \
    'ai-session _hook-prepare-commit-msg "$@"'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/post-commit" "_hook_post_commit" \
    'ai-session _hook-post-commit'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/pre-push" "_hook_pre_push" \
    'ai-session _hook-pre-push "$@"'

  # Add Claude Code hook to .claude/settings.json
  _install_claude_hook "$toplevel"

  info "ai-session: initialized in $toplevel"
  info "  .ai/ directory created"
  info "  git hooks installed (prepare-commit-msg, post-commit, pre-push)"
  info "  Claude Code hook added to .claude/settings.json"
}

_install_hook() {
  local hook_file="$1" marker="$2" command="$3"

  if [[ -f "$hook_file" ]]; then
    # Check if already installed
    if grep -q "$marker" "$hook_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Append to existing hook
    cat >> "$hook_file" << EOF

# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  else
    cat > "$hook_file" << EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  fi
  chmod +x "$hook_file"
}

_install_claude_hook() {
  local toplevel="$1"
  local settings_dir="$toplevel/.claude"
  local settings_file="$settings_dir/settings.json"

  mkdir -p "$settings_dir"

  if [[ -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
    # Check if hook already exists
    if jq -e '.hooks.PostToolUse[]? | select(.command == "ai-session _mark-active")' "$settings_file" &>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Merge hook into existing settings
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    jq '
      .hooks //= {} |
      .hooks.PostToolUse //= [] |
      .hooks.PostToolUse += [{"matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "ai-session _mark-active"}]
    ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
  else
    cat > "$settings_file" << 'EOF'
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
  fi
}

cmd_new() {
  local goal="" transcript_path="" from_stdin=false auto_detect=false
  local model="" author="" commit_mode="" repo_path=""
  local -a links=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --goal)       goal="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --transcript) transcript_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --stdin)      from_stdin=true; shift ;;
      --auto)       auto_detect=true; shift ;;
      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --author)     author="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --link)       links+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      --commit)     commit_mode="commit"; shift ;;
      --amend)      commit_mode="amend"; shift ;;
      --repo)       repo_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)            die "unknown option: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$goal" ]] || die "missing --goal"

  local session_id claude_session_id=""
  local slug prefix folder_name session_dir

  # Read breadcrumb if available
  if [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]]; then
    claude_session_id=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -z "$model" ]] && model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  # Generate session ID
  if [[ -n "$claude_session_id" ]]; then
    session_id="$claude_session_id"
  else
    session_id=$(gen_uuid)
  fi

  local sid
  sid=$(short_id "$session_id")
  slug=$(slugify "$goal")
  prefix=$(now_folder_prefix)
  folder_name="${prefix}_${slug}__${sid}"

  # Determine target directory
  local base_dir
  if [[ -n "$repo_path" ]]; then
    base_dir="$repo_path"
  else
    base_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  fi
  session_dir="$base_dir/$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  mkdir -p "$session_dir"

  # Handle transcript
  local transcript_hash=""
  if [[ "$auto_detect" == true ]]; then
    local key jsonl_src
    key=$(claude_project_key)
    jsonl_src=$(find_latest_jsonl "$key" || true)
    if [[ -n "$jsonl_src" ]]; then
      cp "$jsonl_src" "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl"
      jsonl_to_markdown "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
      transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl")"
      # Derive model from JSONL if not set
      if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
        model=$(jq -r 'select(.model) | .model' "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      fi
    fi
  elif [[ "$from_stdin" == true ]]; then
    cat > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.md")"
  elif [[ -n "$transcript_path" ]]; then
    cp "$transcript_path" "$session_dir/"
    local basename_t
    basename_t=$(basename "$transcript_path")
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/$basename_t")"
  fi

  [[ -z "$author" ]] && author=$(git_author)
  [[ -z "$model" ]] && model="unknown"

  # Build links JSON array
  local links_json="[]"
  if [[ ${#links[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    links_json=$(printf '%s\n' "${links[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
  fi

  # Write meta.json
  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg short_id "$sid" \
    --arg created_at "$(now_iso)" \
    --arg author "$author" \
    --arg repo "$(repo_name)" \
    --arg branch "$(current_branch)" \
    --arg goal "$goal" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    --argjson links "$links_json" \
    --arg claude_session_id "$claude_session_id" \
    --arg transcript_hash "$transcript_hash" \
    '{
      session_id: $session_id,
      short_id: $short_id,
      created_at: $created_at,
      author: $author,
      repo: $repo,
      branch: $branch,
      goal: $goal,
      model: $model,
      links: $links,
      commits: [],
      pr: null,
      claude_session_id: (if $claude_session_id == "" then null else $claude_session_id end),
      transcript_hash: (if $transcript_hash == "" then null else $transcript_hash end)
    }' > "$session_dir/meta.json"

  # Handle commit/amend mode
  if [[ "$commit_mode" == "commit" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit -m "ai-session: $goal" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  elif [[ "$commit_mode" == "amend" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit --amend --no-edit \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  fi

  # Output the folder name for callers
  echo "$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
}

cmd_attach() {
  [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session attach <short-id> <sha>..."

  local target_id="$1"; shift
  local -a shas=("$@")

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # Find session directory by short-id
  local session_dir=""
  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
      session_dir="$d"
      break
    fi
  done
  [[ -n "$session_dir" ]] || die "session not found: $target_id"

  local meta="$session_dir/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found in $session_dir"

  # Add commits to meta.json
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --argjson new_commits "$(printf '%s\n' "${shas[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)" \
    '.commits = (.commits + $new_commits | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"

  info "attached ${#shas[@]} commit(s) to session $target_id"
}

cmd_pr() {
  local -a session_ids=()
  local pr_number=""

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --pr) pr_number="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)    session_ids+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # If no PR specified, try current branch
  if [[ -z "$pr_number" ]]; then
    pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || die "no open PR found for current branch; use --pr <number>"
  fi

  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot find PR #$pr_number"

  # If no session IDs, scan commits on this branch vs base
  if [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    local base
    base=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName' 2>/dev/null || echo "main")
    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$base"..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  fi

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { info "no sessions found to link"; return 0; }

  # Update each session's meta.json with PR link
  for sid in "${session_ids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local tmp
        tmp=$(mktemp)
        jq --arg pr "$pr_url" '.pr = $pr' "$d/meta.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$d/meta.json"
      fi
    done
  done

  # Build AI Sessions table for PR body
  local table
  table=$(_build_pr_table "$toplevel" "${session_ids[@]}")

  # Update PR body
  local current_body
  current_body=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json body -q '.body' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  local marker_start="<!-- ai-sessions-start -->"
  local marker_end="<!-- ai-sessions-end -->"
  local new_section
  new_section=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s' "$marker_start" "$table" "$marker_end")

  local new_body
  if echo "$current_body" | grep -q "$marker_start"; then
    # Replace existing section
    new_body=$(echo "$current_body" | sed "/$marker_start/,/$marker_end/c\\
$new_section")
  else
    # Append section
    new_body=$(printf '%s\n\n---\n\n%s' "$current_body" "$new_section")
  fi

  gh pr edit "$pr_number" --body "$new_body"
  info "updated PR #$pr_number with ${#session_ids[@]} session(s)"
}

_build_pr_table() {
  local toplevel="$1"; shift
  local -a sids=("$@")

  echo "### AI Sessions"
  echo ""
  echo "| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |"
  echo "|---------|------|-------|---------|"

  for sid in "${sids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local goal model commits_str
        goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$d/meta.json")
        model=$(jq -r '.model' "$d/meta.json")
        commits_str=$(jq -r '.commits | map(.[0:7]) | join(", ")' "$d/meta.json")
        local rel_path="${d#$toplevel/}"
        echo "| [\`$sid\`]($rel_path) | $goal | $model | $commits_str |"
      fi
    done
  done
}

cmd_list() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local found=false
  for meta in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*/meta.json; do
    [[ -f "$meta" ]] || continue
    found=true
    local sid goal created model
    sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")
    goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")
    created=$(jq -r '.created_at' "$meta")
    model=$(jq -r '.model' "$meta")
    printf '%-10s %-20s %-20s %s\n' "$sid" "$created" "$model" "$goal"
  done

  if [[ "$found" == false ]]; then
    info "no sessions found"
  fi
}

cmd_show() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session show <short-id>"
  local target_id="$1"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
      jq . "$d/meta.json"
      return 0
    fi
  done

  die "session not found: $target_id"
}

cmd_resume() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>"

  local target="$1"
  local session_path=""

  if [[ "$target" == "--pr" ]]; then
    [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume --pr <number>"
    local pr_num="$2"
    # Find commits from PR, look for session trailers
    local sha
    sha=$(gh pr view "$pr_num" --json commits -q '.commits[-1].oid' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot read PR #$pr_num"
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$sha" "Claude-Session-Path")
  else
    # Treat as a commit SHA (or ref like HEAD)
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$target" "Claude-Session-Path")
  fi

  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || die "no Claude-Session-Path trailer found"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local full_path="$toplevel/$session_path"
  [[ -d "$full_path" ]] || die "session directory not found: $full_path"

  local meta="$full_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found"

  local claude_sid
  claude_sid=$(jq -r '.claude_session_id // empty' "$meta")

  info "session: $(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")"
  info "goal:    $(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")"
  info "model:   $(jq -r '.model' "$meta")"

  if [[ -n "$claude_sid" ]]; then
    info "resuming Claude Code session: $claude_sid"
    exec claude --resume "$claude_sid"
  else
    info "no Claude session ID available; launching new session with transcript context"
    if [[ -f "$full_path/transcript.md" ]]; then
      exec claude --prompt "Previous session transcript is at: $full_path/transcript.md"
    else
      exec claude
    fi
  fi
}

cmd_mark_active() {
  # Internal: write breadcrumb file
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  cd "$toplevel"

  mkdir -p "$AI_DIR"

  local session_id model timestamp
  session_id="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(gen_uuid)}"
  model="${CLAUDE_MODEL:-unknown}"
  timestamp=$(now_iso)

  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    '{session_id: $session_id, timestamp: $timestamp, model: $model}' \
    > "$BREADCRUMB"
}

# ─── Hook Subcommands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg() {
  local msg_file="${1:-}"
  local commit_source="${2:-}"
  local commit_sha="${3:-}"

  # Skip for merge/squash/amend commits
  [[ "$commit_source" == "merge" || "$commit_source" == "squash" ]] && return 0

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Check breadcrumb
  [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]] || return 0

  local age
  age=$(file_age_hours "$BREADCRUMB")
  (( age < STALE_HOURS )) || { rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"; return 0; }

  # Read first line of commit message as goal
  local first_line
  first_line=$(head -1 "$msg_file" | sed 's/^#.*//; s/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
  [[ -n "$first_line" ]] || return 0

  # Create session
  local session_path
  session_path=$(cmd_new --goal "$first_line" --auto 2>/dev/null) || return 0

  # Read short_id from the created meta.json
  local sid
  sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$sid" ]] || return 0

  # Stage session files
  git add "$session_path" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Append trailers to commit message
  # Use git interpret-trailers for proper formatting
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  git interpret-trailers \
    --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
    --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $session_path" \
    --in-place "$msg_file" 2>/dev/null || {
    # Fallback: manually append
    printf '\n\nClaude-Session: %s\nClaude-Session-Path: %s\n' "$sid" "$session_path" >> "$msg_file"
  }

  # Remove breadcrumb
  rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"
}

cmd_hook_post_commit() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  local session_path
  session_path=$(get_trailer HEAD "Claude-Session-Path")
  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || return 0

  local meta="$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || return 0

  local commit_sha
  commit_sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

  # Backfill commit SHA into meta.json (dirty write, no amend)
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --arg sha "$commit_sha" '.commits = (.commits + [$sha] | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"
}

cmd_hook_pre_push() {
  local remote="${1:-origin}"
  local url="${2:-}"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Collect session IDs from commits being pushed
  local -a session_ids=()

  # Read stdin for refs being pushed
  while IFS=' ' read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do

  # Auto-update PR body

# ai-session

**Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts, linked bidirectionally to commits and PRs.**

Every time you use Claude Code to write code and then `git commit`, the conversation that produced that code is automatically captured — stored right in your repo, traceable from the commit, and surfaced on your pull request.

No extra steps. No copy-pasting. Just `claude`, `git commit`, `git push`.

```
commit a1f29c3 — Fix race condition in websocket reconnect

  Claude-Session: 2d8dfda4
  Claude-Session-Path: .ai/sessions/2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition-in-websocket-reconnec__2d8dfda4
```

## Why

Code tells you *what* changed. Commit messages tell you the *intent*. But neither captures the *reasoning* — the back-and-forth where you explored alternatives, debugged edge cases, and arrived at a solution.

When you work with Claude Code, that reasoning exists in the conversation transcript. `ai-session` makes sure it doesn't evaporate when the terminal closes:

- **Code review** — reviewers can read the AI conversation to understand *why* the code looks the way it does
- **Onboarding** — new team members trace commits back to the full problem-solving context
- **Debugging** — when something breaks, you can see exactly what Claude was told and what it considered
- **Audit trail** — every AI-assisted change is linked, hashed, and versioned alongside the code it produced
- **Session resume** — pick up exactly where you left off, even weeks later

## How it works

```
┌─────────────┐     PostToolUse hook      ┌──────────────────┐
│ Claude Code  │ ──────────────────────▶  │ .ai/.active-session │
│  (you work)  │   writes breadcrumb      │   (ephemeral)       │
└─────────────┘                           └────────┬─────────┘
                                                   │
┌─────────────┐     prepare-commit-msg    ┌────────▼─────────┐
│ git commit   │ ◀────────────────────── │ ai-session hook   │
│              │   creates session,       │  • creates folder │
│              │   adds trailers,         │  • copies transcript│
│              │   stages .ai/sessions/   │  • injects trailers│
└──────┬──────┘                           └──────────────────┘
       │
       │            post-commit
       ├──────────────────────────────▶ backfills commit SHA
       │                                into meta.json
       │
       │            pre-push
       └──────────────────────────────▶ auto-updates PR body
                                        with sessions table
```

Three git hooks, one Claude Code hook. All installed with a single command.

## Quick start

### Install

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/your-org/ai-session.git

# Add to PATH (pick one)
ln -s "$PWD/ai-session/ai-session" ~/.local/bin/ai-session
# or
export PATH="$PWD/ai-session:$PATH"  # add to .bashrc/.zshrc
```

**Dependencies:** `bash`, `git`, `jq`. Optional: `gh` (for PR integration).

### Set up a repo

```bash
cd your-project
ai-session init
```

This creates the `.ai/` directory, installs three git hooks, and adds a Claude Code `PostToolUse` hook to `.claude/settings.json`.

### Use it

There's nothing else to do. Work normally:

```bash
claude                       # work with Claude Code
git add -p && git commit     # session auto-captured, trailers added
git push                     # PR body auto-updated
```

Your commit message will have trailers appended:

```
Claude-Session: 2d8dfda4
Claude-Session-Path: .ai/sessions/2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition__2d8dfda4
```

And your PR gets an AI Sessions table:

| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |
|---------|------|-------|---------|
| `2d8dfda4` | Fix race condition in websocket reconnect | claude-opus-4-6 | a1f29c3 |

## What gets stored

```
.ai/
  sessions/
    2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition-in-websocket-reconnec__2d8dfda4/
      meta.json            # structured metadata
      transcript.jsonl     # raw Claude Code transcript
      transcript.md        # human-readable markdown conversion
```

**`meta.json`** ties everything together:

```json
{
  "session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "short_id": "2d8dfda4",
  "created_at": "2026-02-22T07:15:00Z",
  "author": "grant",
  "repo": "my-project",
  "branch": "fix/websocket-reconnect",
  "goal": "Fix race condition in websocket reconnect",
  "model": "claude-opus-4-6",
  "commits": ["a1f29c3"],
  "pr": "https://github.com/org/repo/pull/42",
  "claude_session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "transcript_hash": "sha256:a3f2..."
}
```

## Commands

### `ai-session init`

One-time setup per repo. Creates `.ai/`, installs git hooks, configures Claude Code hook. Safe to run again — idempotent.

### `ai-session list`

```
$ ai-session list
2d8dfda4   2026-02-22T07:15:00Z claude-opus-4-6      Fix race condition in websocket reconnect
a9c3e1f0   2026-02-22T09:30:00Z claude-sonnet-4-6    Add unit tests for auth module
```

### `ai-session show <id>`

Print full session metadata as JSON.

### `ai-session new`

Manually create a session. Normally the git hooks handle this, but useful for edge cases.

```bash
# Capture current Claude session with a goal
ai-session new --goal "Refactor database layer" --auto

# Capture and immediately commit
ai-session new --goal "Add retry logic" --auto --commit

# Pipe in a transcript
cat notes.md | ai-session new --goal "Design review" --stdin

# With extra metadata
ai-session new --goal "Fix auth bug" --auto \
  --model claude-opus-4-6 \
  --link https://linear.app/team/issue/ENG-123
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--goal "..."` | Summary (required) |
| `--auto` | Auto-detect latest Claude Code transcript |
| `--transcript <path>` | Provide a transcript file |
| `--stdin` | Read transcript from stdin |
| `--model <name>` | Model name (auto-detected from breadcrumb/JSONL when possible) |
| `--author <name>` | Author (default: `git config user.name`) |
| `--link <url>` | Arbitrary URL, repeatable |
| `--commit` | Stage + commit with trailers |
| `--amend` | Amend last commit with trailers |
| `--repo <path>` | Store in an external repo instead |

### `ai-session attach <id> <sha>...`

Retroactively link a session to commits that were made without the hook active.

```bash
ai-session attach 2d8dfda4 abc1234 def5678
```

### `ai-session pr [<id>...] --pr <N>`

Link sessions to a pull request and inject an AI Sessions table into the PR body.

```bash
# Auto-detect: scan current branch for session trailers, update current PR
ai-session pr

# Explicit
ai-session pr 2d8dfda4 a9c3e1f0 --pr 42
```

### `ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>`

Relaunch Claude Code with a previous session's context.

```bash
# Resume from a commit
ai-session resume HEAD
ai-session resume abc1234

# Resume from the latest commit on a PR
ai-session resume --pr 42
```

## How the automation works

### Layer 1: Claude Code hook

When Claude Code edits a file (via `Edit` or `Write` tools), a `PostToolUse` hook fires and writes `.ai/.active-session` — a small JSON breadcrumb with the session ID, timestamp, and model. This file is gitignored.

### Layer 2: Git hooks

**`prepare-commit-msg`** checks for the breadcrumb. If it exists and is fresh (< 2 hours), the hook:
1. Uses the commit message's first line as the session goal
2. Creates the session folder with `meta.json` and transcript files
3. Stages everything under `.ai/sessions/`
4. Appends `Claude-Session` and `Claude-Session-Path` trailers to the commit message
5. Removes the breadcrumb

**`post-commit`** reads the trailers from the new commit and backfills the commit SHA into `meta.json`.

**`pre-push`** scans outgoing commits for session trailers. If the current branch has an open PR, it auto-updates the PR body with an AI Sessions table.

If no breadcrumb exists (you're making a normal commit without Claude), all hooks silently no-op.

## FAQ

**Does this slow down my commits?**
No. The hooks add ~100ms for session creation. If there's no active Claude session, they're instant no-ops.

**What if I don't want a session for a particular commit?**
Delete `.ai/.active-session` before committing, or just don't use Claude for that change — the hook only fires when the breadcrumb exists.

**Can I use this without Claude Code?**
Yes. Use `ai-session new --goal "..." --transcript my-notes.md --commit` to manually attach any document to a commit.

**Does this work with other git hook managers (husky, lefthook, etc.)?**
The hooks are thin shell wrappers. You can copy the one-liner from each hook into your existing hook manager config.

**How big are the transcripts?**
Varies. A typical Claude Code session produces 10-100KB of JSONL. For large repos, consider using `--repo` to store sessions in a separate repository.

**Can I strip sessions from history later?**
Yes — they're regular files. Use `git filter-repo` or similar tools to remove `.ai/sessions/` from history if needed.

## License

MIT

Good question. Yes — you should commit both, but for different reasons:

- **`.ai/sessions/`** and **`.ai/.gitignore`** — these are the session storage directory and the rule that keeps the ephemeral breadcrumb out of git. Committing them means teammates get the session history and the directory structure is ready for hooks to write into.

The only thing that *shouldn't* be committed is `.ai/.active-session`, which is already handled by the `.ai/.gitignore` that `init` creates.

Want me to update the README's quick start section to mention this? Something like:

```bash
ai-session init
git add .ai .claude/settings.json
git commit -m "Set up ai-session"
```

# ai-session

**Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts, linked bidirectionally to commits and PRs.**

Every time you use Claude Code to write code and then `git commit`, the conversation that produced that code is automatically captured — stored right in your repo, traceable from the commit, and surfaced on your pull request.

No extra steps. No copy-pasting. Just `claude`, `git commit`, `git push`.

```
commit a1f29c3 — Fix race condition in websocket reconnect

  Claude-Session: 2d8dfda4
  Claude-Session-Path: .ai/sessions/2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition-in-websocket-reconnec__2d8dfda4
```

## Why

Code tells you *what* changed. Commit messages tell you the *intent*. But neither captures the *reasoning* — the back-and-forth where you explored alternatives, debugged edge cases, and arrived at a solution.

When you work with Claude Code, that reasoning exists in the conversation transcript. `ai-session` makes sure it doesn't evaporate when the terminal closes:

- **Code review** — reviewers can read the AI conversation to understand *why* the code looks the way it does
- **Onboarding** — new team members trace commits back to the full problem-solving context
- **Debugging** — when something breaks, you can see exactly what Claude was told and what it considered
- **Audit trail** — every AI-assisted change is linked, hashed, and versioned alongside the code it produced
- **Session resume** — pick up exactly where you left off, even weeks later

## How it works

```
┌─────────────┐     PostToolUse hook      ┌──────────────────┐
│ Claude Code  │ ──────────────────────▶  │ .ai/.active-session │
│  (you work)  │   writes breadcrumb      │   (ephemeral)       │
└─────────────┘                           └────────┬─────────┘
                                                   │
┌─────────────┐     prepare-commit-msg    ┌────────▼─────────┐
│ git commit   │ ◀────────────────────── │ ai-session hook   │
│              │   creates session,       │  • creates folder │
│              │   adds trailers,         │  • copies transcript│
│              │   stages .ai/sessions/   │  • injects trailers│
└──────┬──────┘                           └──────────────────┘
       │
       │            post-commit
       ├──────────────────────────────▶ backfills commit SHA
       │                                into meta.json
       │
       │            pre-push
       └──────────────────────────────▶ auto-updates PR body
                                        with sessions table
```

Three git hooks, one Claude Code hook. All installed with a single command.

## Quick start

### Install

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/your-org/ai-session.git

# Add to PATH (pick one)
ln -s "$PWD/ai-session/ai-session" ~/.local/bin/ai-session
# or
export PATH="$PWD/ai-session:$PATH"  # add to .bashrc/.zshrc
```

**Dependencies:** `bash`, `git`, `jq`. Optional: `gh` (for PR integration).

### Set up a repo

```bash
cd your-project
ai-session init
```

This creates the `.ai/` directory, installs three git hooks, and adds a Claude Code `PostToolUse` hook to `.claude/settings.json`.

### Use it

There's nothing else to do. Work normally:

```bash
claude                       # work with Claude Code
git add -p && git commit     # session auto-captured, trailers added
git push                     # PR body auto-updated
```

Your commit message will have trailers appended:

```
Claude-Session: 2d8dfda4
Claude-Session-Path: .ai/sessions/2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition__2d8dfda4
```

And your PR gets an AI Sessions table:

| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |
|---------|------|-------|---------|
| `2d8dfda4` | Fix race condition in websocket reconnect | claude-opus-4-6 | a1f29c3 |

## What gets stored

```
.ai/
  sessions/
    2026-02-22_0715Z_fix-race-condition-in-websocket-reconnec__2d8dfda4/
      meta.json            # structured metadata
      transcript.jsonl     # raw Claude Code transcript
      transcript.md        # human-readable markdown conversion
```

**`meta.json`** ties everything together:

```json
{
  "session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "short_id": "2d8dfda4",
  "created_at": "2026-02-22T07:15:00Z",
  "author": "grant",
  "repo": "my-project",
  "branch": "fix/websocket-reconnect",
  "goal": "Fix race condition in websocket reconnect",
  "model": "claude-opus-4-6",
  "commits": ["a1f29c3"],
  "pr": "https://github.com/org/repo/pull/42",
  "claude_session_id": "2d8dfda4-b60c-4ffe-ace9-b66d93392823",
  "transcript_hash": "sha256:a3f2..."
}
```

## Commands

### `ai-session init`

One-time setup per repo. Creates `.ai/`, installs git hooks, configures Claude Code hook. Safe to run again — idempotent.

### `ai-session list`

```
$ ai-session list
2d8dfda4   2026-02-22T07:15:00Z claude-opus-4-6      Fix race condition in websocket reconnect
a9c3e1f0   2026-02-22T09:30:00Z claude-sonnet-4-6    Add unit tests for auth module
```

### `ai-session show <id>`

Print full session metadata as JSON.

### `ai-session new`

Manually create a session. Normally the git hooks handle this, but useful for edge cases.

```bash
# Capture current Claude session with a goal
ai-session new --goal "Refactor database layer" --auto

# Capture and immediately commit
ai-session new --goal "Add retry logic" --auto --commit

# Pipe in a transcript
cat notes.md | ai-session new --goal "Design review" --stdin

# With extra metadata
ai-session new --goal "Fix auth bug" --auto \
  --model claude-opus-4-6 \
  --link https://linear.app/team/issue/ENG-123
```

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--goal "..."` | Summary (required) |
| `--auto` | Auto-detect latest Claude Code transcript |
| `--transcript <path>` | Provide a transcript file |
| `--stdin` | Read transcript from stdin |
| `--model <name>` | Model name (auto-detected from breadcrumb/JSONL when possible) |
| `--author <name>` | Author (default: `git config user.name`) |
| `--link <url>` | Arbitrary URL, repeatable |
| `--commit` | Stage + commit with trailers |
| `--amend` | Amend last commit with trailers |
| `--repo <path>` | Store in an external repo instead |

### `ai-session attach <id> <sha>...`

Retroactively link a session to commits that were made without the hook active.

```bash
ai-session attach 2d8dfda4 abc1234 def5678
```

### `ai-session pr [<id>...] --pr <N>`

Link sessions to a pull request and inject an AI Sessions table into the PR body.

```bash
# Auto-detect: scan current branch for session trailers, update current PR
ai-session pr

# Explicit
ai-session pr 2d8dfda4 a9c3e1f0 --pr 42
```

### `ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>`

Relaunch Claude Code with a previous session's context.

```bash
# Resume from a commit
ai-session resume HEAD
ai-session resume abc1234

# Resume from the latest commit on a PR
ai-session resume --pr 42
```

## How the automation works

### Layer 1: Claude Code hook

When Claude Code edits a file (via `Edit` or `Write` tools), a `PostToolUse` hook fires and writes `.ai/.active-session` — a small JSON breadcrumb with the session ID, timestamp, and model. This file is gitignored.

### Layer 2: Git hooks

**`prepare-commit-msg`** checks for the breadcrumb. If it exists and is fresh (< 2 hours), the hook:
1. Uses the commit message's first line as the session goal
2. Creates the session folder with `meta.json` and transcript files
3. Stages everything under `.ai/sessions/`
4. Appends `Claude-Session` and `Claude-Session-Path` trailers to the commit message
5. Removes the breadcrumb

**`post-commit`** reads the trailers from the new commit and backfills the commit SHA into `meta.json`.

**`pre-push`** scans outgoing commits for session trailers. If the current branch has an open PR, it auto-updates the PR body with an AI Sessions table.

If no breadcrumb exists (you're making a normal commit without Claude), all hooks silently no-op.

## FAQ

**Does this slow down my commits?**
No. The hooks add ~100ms for session creation. If there's no active Claude session, they're instant no-ops.

**What if I don't want a session for a particular commit?**
Delete `.ai/.active-session` before committing, or just don't use Claude for that change — the hook only fires when the breadcrumb exists.

**Can I use this without Claude Code?**
Yes. Use `ai-session new --goal "..." --transcript my-notes.md --commit` to manually attach any document to a commit.

**Does this work with other git hook managers (husky, lefthook, etc.)?**
The hooks are thin shell wrappers. You can copy the one-liner from each hook into your existing hook manager config.

**How big are the transcripts?**
Varies. A typical Claude Code session produces 10-100KB of JSONL. For large repos, consider using `--repo` to store sessions in a separate repository.

**Can I strip sessions from history later?**
Yes — they're regular files. Use `git filter-repo` or similar tools to remove `.ai/sessions/` from history if needed.

## License

MIT

_install_claude_hook() {
  local toplevel="$1"
  local settings_dir="$toplevel/.claude"
  local settings_file="$settings_dir/settings.json"

  mkdir -p "$settings_dir"

  if [[ -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
    # Check if hook already exists
    if jq -e '.hooks.PostToolUse[]? | select(.command == "ai-session _mark-active")' "$settings_file" &>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Merge hook into existing settings
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    jq '
      .hooks //= {} |
      .hooks.PostToolUse //= [] |
      .hooks.PostToolUse += [{"matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "ai-session _mark-active"}]
    ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
  else
    cat > "$settings_file" << 'EOF'
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
  fi
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts
# Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

VERSION="0.1.0"
AI_DIR=".ai"
SESSIONS_DIR="$AI_DIR/sessions"
BREADCRUMB="$AI_DIR/.active-session"
STALE_HOURS=2

# ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

die()  { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
info() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; }

slugify() {
  # kebab-case, truncate to 40 chars
  printf '%s' "$1" \
    | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' \
    | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//' \
    | cut -c1-40
}

short_id() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | cut -c1-8
}

now_iso() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
}

now_folder_prefix() {
  date -u '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%MZ'
}

gen_uuid() {
  if command -v uuidgen &>/dev/null; then
    uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'
  elif [[ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid ]]; then
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid
  else
    python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'
  fi
}

file_age_hours() {
  local file="$1"
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
    echo 9999
    return
  fi
  local now file_epoch
  now=$(date +%s)
  file_epoch=$(stat -c '%Y' "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%m' "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  echo $(( (now - file_epoch) / 3600 ))
}

repo_name() {
  basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
}

current_branch() {
  git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

git_author() {
  git config user.name 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"
}

# Derive Claude Code project key from pwd
claude_project_key() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  printf '%s' "$toplevel" | sed 's|/|-|g'
}

# Find most recent JSONL in Claude projects dir
find_latest_jsonl() {
  local key="$1"
  local projects_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$key"
  if [[ ! -d "$projects_dir" ]]; then
    return 1
  fi
  # Find most recently modified .jsonl
  find "$projects_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.jsonl' -printf '%T@\t%p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -f2
}

# Convert JSONL transcript to Markdown
jsonl_to_markdown() {
  local jsonl_path="$1"
  jq -r '
    if .type == "human" then
      "\n## User\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "array" then
          [.message[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
        elif (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    elif .type == "assistant" then
      "\n## Assistant\n\n" + (
        if (.message | type) == "object" and .message.content then
          if (.message.content | type) == "array" then
            [.message.content[] | select(.type == "text") | .text] | join("\n")
          else
            (.message.content // "")
          end
        elif (.message | type) == "string" then
          .message
        else
          ""
        end
      )
    else
      empty
    end
  ' "$jsonl_path" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# Compute sha256 hash of a file
file_sha256() {
  if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
    sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
    shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
  else
    echo "unknown"
  fi
}

# Read a trailer value from git commit message
get_trailer() {
  local commit="$1" trailer="$2"
  git log -1 --format='%(trailers:key='"$trailer"',valueonly)' "$commit" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

# ─── Subcommands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_init() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Create .ai directory structure
  mkdir -p "$SESSIONS_DIR"

  # Create .ai/.gitignore
  cat > "$AI_DIR/.gitignore" << 'EOF'
.active-session
EOF

  # Install git hooks
  local hooks_dir="$toplevel/.git/hooks"
  mkdir -p "$hooks_dir"

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/prepare-commit-msg" "_hook_prepare_commit_msg" \
    'ai-session _hook-prepare-commit-msg "$@"'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/post-commit" "_hook_post_commit" \
    'ai-session _hook-post-commit'

  _install_hook "$hooks_dir/pre-push" "_hook_pre_push" \
    'ai-session _hook-pre-push "$@"'

  # Add Claude Code hook to .claude/settings.json
  _install_claude_hook "$toplevel"

  info "ai-session: initialized in $toplevel"
  info "  .ai/ directory created"
  info "  git hooks installed (prepare-commit-msg, post-commit, pre-push)"
  info "  Claude Code hook added to .claude/settings.json"
}

_install_hook() {
  local hook_file="$1" marker="$2" command="$3"

  if [[ -f "$hook_file" ]]; then
    # Check if already installed
    if grep -q "$marker" "$hook_file" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Append to existing hook
    cat >> "$hook_file" << EOF

# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  else
    cat > "$hook_file" << EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ai-session: $marker
$command
EOF
  fi
  chmod +x "$hook_file"
}

_install_claude_hook() {
  local toplevel="$1"
  local settings_dir="$toplevel/.claude"
  local settings_file="$settings_dir/settings.json"

  mkdir -p "$settings_dir"

  if [[ -f "$settings_file" ]]; then
    # Check if hook already exists
    if jq -e '.hooks.PostToolUse[]? | select(.command == "ai-session _mark-active")' "$settings_file" &>/dev/null; then
      return 0
    fi
    # Merge hook into existing settings
    local tmp
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    jq '
      .hooks //= {} |
      .hooks.PostToolUse //= [] |
      .hooks.PostToolUse += [{"matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "ai-session _mark-active"}]
    ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
  else
    cat > "$settings_file" << 'EOF'
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write",
        "command": "ai-session _mark-active"
      }
    ]
  }
}
EOF
  fi
}

cmd_new() {
  local goal="" transcript_path="" from_stdin=false auto_detect=false
  local model="" author="" commit_mode="" repo_path=""
  local -a links=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --goal)       goal="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --transcript) transcript_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --stdin)      from_stdin=true; shift ;;
      --auto)       auto_detect=true; shift ;;
      --model)      model="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --author)     author="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --link)       links+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      --commit)     commit_mode="commit"; shift ;;
      --amend)      commit_mode="amend"; shift ;;
      --repo)       repo_path="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)            die "unknown option: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$goal" ]] || die "missing --goal"

  local session_id claude_session_id=""
  local slug prefix folder_name session_dir

  # Read breadcrumb if available
  if [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]]; then
    claude_session_id=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -z "$model" ]] && model=$(jq -r '.model // empty' "$BREADCRUMB" 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  # Generate session ID
  if [[ -n "$claude_session_id" ]]; then
    session_id="$claude_session_id"
  else
    session_id=$(gen_uuid)
  fi

  local sid
  sid=$(short_id "$session_id")
  slug=$(slugify "$goal")
  prefix=$(now_folder_prefix)
  folder_name="${prefix}_${slug}__${sid}"

  # Determine target directory
  local base_dir
  if [[ -n "$repo_path" ]]; then
    base_dir="$repo_path"
  else
    base_dir="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  fi
  session_dir="$base_dir/$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  mkdir -p "$session_dir"

  # Handle transcript
  local transcript_hash=""
  if [[ "$auto_detect" == true ]]; then
    local key jsonl_src
    key=$(claude_project_key)
    jsonl_src=$(find_latest_jsonl "$key" || true)
    if [[ -n "$jsonl_src" ]]; then
      cp "$jsonl_src" "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl"
      jsonl_to_markdown "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
      transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl")"
      # Derive model from JSONL if not set
      if [[ -z "$model" ]]; then
        model=$(jq -r 'select(.model) | .model' "$session_dir/transcript.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
      fi
    fi
  elif [[ "$from_stdin" == true ]]; then
    cat > "$session_dir/transcript.md"
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/transcript.md")"
  elif [[ -n "$transcript_path" ]]; then
    cp "$transcript_path" "$session_dir/"
    local basename_t
    basename_t=$(basename "$transcript_path")
    transcript_hash="sha256:$(file_sha256 "$session_dir/$basename_t")"
  fi

  [[ -z "$author" ]] && author=$(git_author)
  [[ -z "$model" ]] && model="unknown"

  # Build links JSON array
  local links_json="[]"
  if [[ ${#links[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    links_json=$(printf '%s\n' "${links[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)
  fi

  # Write meta.json
  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg short_id "$sid" \
    --arg created_at "$(now_iso)" \
    --arg author "$author" \
    --arg repo "$(repo_name)" \
    --arg branch "$(current_branch)" \
    --arg goal "$goal" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    --argjson links "$links_json" \
    --arg claude_session_id "$claude_session_id" \
    --arg transcript_hash "$transcript_hash" \
    '{
      session_id: $session_id,
      short_id: $short_id,
      created_at: $created_at,
      author: $author,
      repo: $repo,
      branch: $branch,
      goal: $goal,
      model: $model,
      links: $links,
      commits: [],
      pr: null,
      claude_session_id: (if $claude_session_id == "" then null else $claude_session_id end),
      transcript_hash: (if $transcript_hash == "" then null else $transcript_hash end)
    }' > "$session_dir/meta.json"

  # Handle commit/amend mode
  if [[ "$commit_mode" == "commit" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit -m "ai-session: $goal" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  elif [[ "$commit_mode" == "amend" ]]; then
    git add "$session_dir"
    git commit --amend --no-edit \
      --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
      --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
  fi

  # Output the folder name for callers
  echo "$SESSIONS_DIR/$folder_name"
}

cmd_attach() {
  [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session attach <short-id> <sha>..."

  local target_id="$1"; shift
  local -a shas=("$@")

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # Find session directory by short-id
  local session_dir=""
  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" ]]; then
      session_dir="$d"
      break
    fi
  done
  [[ -n "$session_dir" ]] || die "session not found: $target_id"

  local meta="$session_dir/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found in $session_dir"

  # Add commits to meta.json
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --argjson new_commits "$(printf '%s\n' "${shas[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -s .)" \
    '.commits = (.commits + $new_commits | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"

  info "attached ${#shas[@]} commit(s) to session $target_id"
}

cmd_pr() {
  local -a session_ids=()
  local pr_number=""

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --pr) pr_number="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      *)    session_ids+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  # If no PR specified, try current branch
  if [[ -z "$pr_number" ]]; then
    pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
    [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || die "no open PR found for current branch; use --pr <number>"
  fi

  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json url -q '.url' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot find PR #$pr_number"

  # If no session IDs, scan commits on this branch vs base
  if [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    local base
    base=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json baseRefName -q '.baseRefName' 2>/dev/null || echo "main")
    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$base"..HEAD --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  fi

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || { info "no sessions found to link"; return 0; }

  # Update each session's meta.json with PR link
  for sid in "${session_ids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local tmp
        tmp=$(mktemp)
        jq --arg pr "$pr_url" '.pr = $pr' "$d/meta.json" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$d/meta.json"
      fi
    done
  done

  # Build AI Sessions table for PR body
  local table
  table=$(_build_pr_table "$toplevel" "${session_ids[@]}")

  # Update PR body
  local current_body
  current_body=$(gh pr view "$pr_number" --json body -q '.body' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  local marker_start="<!-- ai-sessions-start -->"
  local marker_end="<!-- ai-sessions-end -->"
  local new_section
  new_section=$(printf '%s\n\n%s\n\n%s' "$marker_start" "$table" "$marker_end")

  local new_body
  if echo "$current_body" | grep -q "$marker_start"; then
    # Replace existing section
    new_body=$(echo "$current_body" | sed "/$marker_start/,/$marker_end/c\\
$new_section")
  else
    # Append section
    new_body=$(printf '%s\n\n---\n\n%s' "$current_body" "$new_section")
  fi

  gh pr edit "$pr_number" --body "$new_body"
  info "updated PR #$pr_number with ${#session_ids[@]} session(s)"
}

_build_pr_table() {
  local toplevel="$1"; shift
  local -a sids=("$@")

  echo "### AI Sessions"
  echo ""
  echo "| Session | Goal | Model | Commits |"
  echo "|---------|------|-------|---------|"

  for sid in "${sids[@]}"; do
    for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${sid}"/; do
      if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
        local goal model commits_str
        goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$d/meta.json")
        model=$(jq -r '.model' "$d/meta.json")
        commits_str=$(jq -r '.commits | map(.[0:7]) | join(", ")' "$d/meta.json")
        local rel_path="${d#$toplevel/}"
        echo "| [\`$sid\`]($rel_path) | $goal | $model | $commits_str |"
      fi
    done
  done
}

cmd_list() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local found=false
  for meta in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*/meta.json; do
    [[ -f "$meta" ]] || continue
    found=true
    local sid goal created model
    sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")
    goal=$(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")
    created=$(jq -r '.created_at' "$meta")
    model=$(jq -r '.model' "$meta")
    printf '%-10s %-20s %-20s %s\n' "$sid" "$created" "$model" "$goal"
  done

  if [[ "$found" == false ]]; then
    info "no sessions found"
  fi
}

cmd_show() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session show <short-id>"
  local target_id="$1"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  for d in "$toplevel/$SESSIONS_DIR"/*"__${target_id}"/; do
    if [[ -d "$d" && -f "$d/meta.json" ]]; then
      jq . "$d/meta.json"
      return 0
    fi
  done

  die "session not found: $target_id"
}

cmd_resume() {
  [[ $# -ge 1 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume <sha|--pr N>"

  local target="$1"
  local session_path=""

  if [[ "$target" == "--pr" ]]; then
    [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || die "usage: ai-session resume --pr <number>"
    local pr_num="$2"
    # Find commits from PR, look for session trailers
    local sha
    sha=$(gh pr view "$pr_num" --json commits -q '.commits[-1].oid' 2>/dev/null) || die "cannot read PR #$pr_num"
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$sha" "Claude-Session-Path")
  else
    # Treat as a commit SHA (or ref like HEAD)
    session_path=$(get_trailer "$target" "Claude-Session-Path")
  fi

  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || die "no Claude-Session-Path trailer found"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die "not a git repository"

  local full_path="$toplevel/$session_path"
  [[ -d "$full_path" ]] || die "session directory not found: $full_path"

  local meta="$full_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || die "meta.json not found"

  local claude_sid
  claude_sid=$(jq -r '.claude_session_id // empty' "$meta")

  info "session: $(jq -r '.short_id' "$meta")"
  info "goal:    $(jq -r '.goal' "$meta")"
  info "model:   $(jq -r '.model' "$meta")"

  if [[ -n "$claude_sid" ]]; then
    info "resuming Claude Code session: $claude_sid"
    exec claude --resume "$claude_sid"
  else
    info "no Claude session ID available; launching new session with transcript context"
    if [[ -f "$full_path/transcript.md" ]]; then
      exec claude --prompt "Previous session transcript is at: $full_path/transcript.md"
    else
      exec claude
    fi
  fi
}

cmd_mark_active() {
  # Internal: write breadcrumb file
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
  cd "$toplevel"

  mkdir -p "$AI_DIR"

  local session_id model timestamp
  session_id="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(gen_uuid)}"
  model="${CLAUDE_MODEL:-unknown}"
  timestamp=$(now_iso)

  jq -n \
    --arg session_id "$session_id" \
    --arg timestamp "$timestamp" \
    --arg model "$model" \
    '{session_id: $session_id, timestamp: $timestamp, model: $model}' \
    > "$BREADCRUMB"
}

# ─── Hook Subcommands ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg() {
  local msg_file="${1:-}"
  local commit_source="${2:-}"
  local commit_sha="${3:-}"

  # Skip for merge/squash/amend commits
  [[ "$commit_source" == "merge" || "$commit_source" == "squash" ]] && return 0

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Check breadcrumb
  [[ -f "$BREADCRUMB" ]] || return 0

  local age
  age=$(file_age_hours "$BREADCRUMB")
  (( age < STALE_HOURS )) || { rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"; return 0; }

  # Read first line of commit message as goal
  local first_line
  first_line=$(head -1 "$msg_file" | sed 's/^#.*//; s/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
  [[ -n "$first_line" ]] || return 0

  # Create session
  local session_path
  session_path=$(cmd_new --goal "$first_line" --auto 2>/dev/null) || return 0

  # Read short_id from the created meta.json
  local sid
  sid=$(jq -r '.short_id' "$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$sid" ]] || return 0

  # Stage session files
  git add "$session_path" 2>/dev/null || true

  # Append trailers to commit message
  # Use git interpret-trailers for proper formatting
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  git interpret-trailers \
    --trailer "Claude-Session: $sid" \
    --trailer "Claude-Session-Path: $session_path" \
    --in-place "$msg_file" 2>/dev/null || {
    # Fallback: manually append
    printf '\n\nClaude-Session: %s\nClaude-Session-Path: %s\n' "$sid" "$session_path" >> "$msg_file"
  }

  # Remove breadcrumb
  rm -f "$BREADCRUMB"
}

cmd_hook_post_commit() {
  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  local session_path
  session_path=$(get_trailer HEAD "Claude-Session-Path")
  [[ -n "$session_path" ]] || return 0

  local meta="$toplevel/$session_path/meta.json"
  [[ -f "$meta" ]] || return 0

  local commit_sha
  commit_sha=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

  # Backfill commit SHA into meta.json (dirty write, no amend)
  local tmp
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  jq --arg sha "$commit_sha" '.commits = (.commits + [$sha] | unique)' "$meta" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$meta"
}

cmd_hook_pre_push() {
  local remote="${1:-origin}"
  local url="${2:-}"

  local toplevel
  toplevel="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cd "$toplevel"

  # Collect session IDs from commits being pushed
  local -a session_ids=()

  # Read stdin for refs being pushed
  while IFS=' ' read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
    [[ "$local_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]] && continue

    local range
    if [[ "$remote_sha" == "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]]; then
      range="$local_sha"
    else
      range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
    fi

    while IFS= read -r sid; do
      [[ -n "$sid" ]] && session_ids+=("$sid")
    done < <(git log "$range" --format='%(trailers:key=Claude-Session,valueonly)' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | sort -u)
  done

  [[ ${#session_ids[@]} -gt 0 ]] || return 0

  # Check if current branch has an open PR
  local pr_number
  pr_number=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$pr_number" ]] || return 0

  # Auto-update PR body
  cmd_pr "${session_ids[@]}" --pr "$pr_number" 2>/dev/null || true
}

# ─── Main Dispatch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cmd_help() {
  cat << 'EOF'
ai-session — Persist Claude Code conversation transcripts as git artifacts

Usage: ai-session <command> [options]

Commands:
  init                Set up hooks + .ai/ directory in current repo
  new                 Create a new session
  attach <id> <sha>   Link session to commit(s)
  pr [<id>...] --pr N Link sessions to PR + update PR body
  list                List all sessions
  show <id>           Print session metadata
  resume <sha|--pr N> Launch Claude Code with linked session
  _mark-active        Internal: write breadcrumb (Claude Code hook)

new flags:
  --goal "..."        Summary (required)
  --transcript <path> Transcript file path
  --stdin             Read transcript from stdin
  --auto              Auto-detect latest Claude Code session
  --model <name>      Model name
  --author <name>     Author (default: git user.name)
  --link <url>        Arbitrary URL (repeatable)
  --commit            Stage + commit with trailers
  --amend             Amend last commit with trailers
  --repo <path>       External ai-log repo
EOF
}

main() {
  local cmd="${1:-help}"
  shift || true

  case "$cmd" in
    init)                    cmd_init "$@" ;;
    new)                     cmd_new "$@" ;;
    attach)                  cmd_attach "$@" ;;
    pr)                      cmd_pr "$@" ;;
    list)                    cmd_list "$@" ;;
    show)                    cmd_show "$@" ;;
    resume)                  cmd_resume "$@" ;;
    _mark-active)            cmd_mark_active "$@" ;;
    _hook-prepare-commit-msg) cmd_hook_prepare_commit_msg "$@" ;;
    _hook-post-commit)       cmd_hook_post_commit "$@" ;;
    _hook-pre-push)          cmd_hook_pre_push "$@" ;;
    help|--help|-h)          cmd_help ;;
    version|--version|-v)    echo "ai-session $VERSION" ;;
    *)                       die "unknown command: $cmd" ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"
